expect: DC 13 and spell attack +5 use Wisdom. Spend one slot per accepted nonfree cast and restore on Long Rest. Prepared/known counts match the independent class table. Higher slots do not unlock higher-class-level preparations.

setup: Normal ranger spell choice with no extra-list grant.
act: Select Hunter's Mark and try an exclusively other-class spell separately.
expect: Hunter's Mark is eligible at its listed level. Other-class choice needs an explicit granting feature. Deferred spells retain list membership with visible availability.

setup: Separate level-5 characters in these classes, plus a multiclass with two ordinary Extra Attack grants.
act: Take the Attack action.
expect: Each permits two attacks. Ordinary Extra Attack grants do not add together. Separate higher-level Fighter features control its later attack counts.

setup: At character levels 1/5/11/17, place two targets in a legal 5-ft sphere and one just outside. Set each d6 to 3.
act: Cast with one failed and one successful Dexterity save inside.
expect: The failed target takes 3/6/9/12 Acid before defenses, the successful target takes zero, and the outside target does not save.

setup: Melee target with a healing effect and a scripted hit for 6 on the d10. Also run a miss.
act: Cast, attempt healing before and after the end of the caster's next turn.
expect: Hit takes 6 Necrotic and cannot heal until that turn boundary. Miss applies neither effect. Healing resumes afterward.

setup: Provide tomorrow's weather and a dormant flower bud within range.
act: Select Weather Sensor and Bloom in separate casts.
expect: Produce the supplied weather cue for one round. Bloom immediately changes the selected bud. Fire Play records eligible fire ignition/extinguishing without a simulated illumination radius.

setup: At levels 1/5/11/17, place two valid creature or object targets in range and fix one d10 to 5 on each hit.
act: Distribute 1/2/3/4 beams among legal targets and resolve separate hits and misses.
expect: Roll separately per beam and apply 5 Force per hit to that beam's target. A miss changes neither target HP nor the result of other beams.

setup: Put an unheld door and a held shutter in a 5-ft cube. Provide an open vessel.
act: Use Beckon Air, then create water with Beckon Water.
expect: Close the unheld door and leave the held shutter open. Create one cup of clean water and remove it after one minute. Embers may ignite eligible objects without inventing a defined illumination radius.

setup: Target an unattended flammable crate and, separately, a creature wearing flammable clothing. Set d10 to 6 and script hits.
act: Cast once at each target.
expect: Each hit deals 6 Fire before defenses at level 1. The crate ignites. The carried clothing is not ignited by the object rider.

setup: A willing touched ally chooses Stealth. Fix the d4 at 3.
act: Make two Stealth checks and one Perception check before expiration, then another Stealth check after concentration ends.
expect: Both pre-expiry Stealth checks gain +3. Perception and post-expiry Stealth receive no bonus.

setup: Put an unlocked door, a locked container and a 12-lb object near the hand.
act: Use the hand on the door, attempt to open the locked container and lift the heavy object, then leave the hand more than 30 ft away.
expect: Door opens. Locked container and heavy object stay unchanged. The hand disappears outside 30 ft.

setup: Provide a mundane object with a 10-inch tear, an object with a 13-inch break and a broken magic item that has lost its magic.
act: Cast on each in separate runs.
expect: The tear repairs completely. The oversized break remains. The magic item's eligible physical break repairs without restoring magic.

setup: Familiar recipient behind a thin wooden panel. Repeat behind a thin sheet of lead and under magical silence.
act: Send a private message and reply.
expect: Behind the wooden panel only caster and recipient receive their respective messages. Lead and magical silence prevent delivery.

setup: Create a 5-ft cube image and put two viewers in range. Fix Investigation above the DC for one viewer.
act: Study with that viewer, physically interact with the other, then recast as a sound.
expect: The image becomes faint to each viewer only after their own discovery. Recasting removes the image and creates the new sound.

setup: A creature is within range at level 1. Fix d12 to 7 and script a hit and a miss in separate runs.
act: Resolve the ranged spell attack.
expect: Hit deals 7 Poison before defenses. Miss deals zero and prompts no saving throw.

setup: Create three one-hour effects on separate eligible objects.
act: Try a fourth concurrent non-instantaneous effect, then let time advance one hour.
expect: The active count never exceeds three and each effect expires at its own boundary. A created trinket cannot deal damage or generate currency.

setup: A target has 30-ft Speed. Set d8 to 5 and script a hit.
act: Cast, then advance to the start of the caster's next turn.
expect: Apply 5 Cold before defenses and reduce Speed to 20 ft until the stated boundary. Restore Speed to 30 ft on expiry.

setup: Willing target selects Fire. Fix the d4 to 3 and apply two 8-point Fire hits on the same turn plus a Cold hit.
act: Apply the reduction on the first Fire hit. Apply another Fire hit on a different turn before expiration.
expect: First Fire hit and first eligible hit on the other turn each deal 5 before other adjustments. Same-turn second hit and Cold hit receive no reduction.

setup: An otherwise visible target has three-quarters cover and a 12 Dexterity save total before the cover bonus. Spell DC is 14 and d8 is 5.
act: Cast through the legal line of effect.
expect: Ignore the cover bonus to this save, so the target fails and takes 5 Radiant before defenses.

setup: Caster has Strength +1 and spellcasting ability +4 and holds a club.
act: Imbue it, choose Force for a hit with a weapon die result of 5, then release the weapon.
expect: The eligible attack uses +4 in place of +1 and deals 9 Force before defenses. Releasing the club removes the modifier and restores its normal die.

setup: Target is adjacent. Fix a hit and 4 on d8.
act: Cast, then offer an Opportunity Attack and a distinct eligible reaction before the target's next turn.
expect: Deal 4 Lightning before defenses. Deny the Opportunity Attack, keep the other reaction eligible and restore Opportunity Attack eligibility at the start of the target's turn.

setup: A level-1 caster has spellcasting modifier +2 and rolls 8, 8, 8 on the initial die and two additional dice.
act: Hit and select Thunder, accepting extra dice when legal.
expect: Deal 24 Thunder before defenses. The third 8 cannot create another die because two extra dice have already been added.

setup: Put a living dying creature and a dead creature within range.
act: Attempt casting on each separately.
expect: The living target becomes Stable and remains at 0 HP. The dead creature is ineligible.

setup: Place an unlocked door in range and provide an eligible Intimidation check.
act: Use Invisible Hand to close the door, cast Booming Voice, then advance a minute.
expect: Door closes immediately. Intimidation has Advantage while the voice effect is active and loses it on expiry. Fire Play cannot modify scene lighting.

setup: Caster has spellcasting modifier +4, Strength +1 and Dexterity +2, with an eligible weapon used as the component. Weapon die rolls 5.
act: Cast and choose Radiant on a scripted hit at level 1.
expect: The one weapon attack uses the spellcasting modifier for attack and damage, and deals 9 Radiant before defenses.

setup: A heard creature fails its Wisdom save and the d6 is 4.
act: Cast, then make two attack rolls for the creature before the end of its next turn.
expect: Apply 4 Psychic before defenses and Disadvantage on its first attack only. An unspent modifier expires at the end of that turn.

setup: Ward a door and exempt one ally. Choose an audible alarm.
act: Have the ally and an intruder touch the door separately before the eight-hour expiry.
expect: The ally raises no alarm. The intruder causes an audible handbell cue for 10 seconds within 60 ft. No trigger remains after expiry.

setup: A visible Beast and visible Humanoid stand in range. Fix the Beast's Wisdom save to fail.
act: Cast on the Beast, damage it with an ally, and independently attempt to target the Humanoid.
expect: Only the Beast is a legal target. It becomes Charmed, and allied damage ends the effect immediately.

setup: Three targets in range, two failed Charisma saves and one success. Fix each d4 to 2.
act: Resolve one attack, one saving throw and one ability check per target.
expect: Subtract 2 from the attacks and saves of the two failed targets only. Ability checks are unchanged.

setup: Three allies in range, with fixed d4 result 2.
act: Roll an attack, a save and a skill check for each. End concentration.
expect: Each target gains +2 on its attack and save only. All bonuses end with concentration.

setup: Put two creatures and a loose flammable object inside a 15-ft cone. Set every d6 to 4.
act: Resolve one failed and one successful Dexterity save.
expect: Apply 12 and 6 Fire before defenses, respectively. The loose object ignites.

setup: Visible Humanoid fighting the caster's allies. Fix two Wisdom dice so only the higher total passes.
act: Cast while fighting and in a noncombat replay with the low die. Then damage the Charmed target.
expect: Combat grants Advantage and succeeds. Noncombat fails and grants Charmed plus Friendly to caster. Allied damage ends the effect and the target learns what happened.

setup: Three targets, two within 30 ft of the first. Choose Cold and fix first hit damage dice to 4, 4, 2.
act: Resolve first hit, choose a different legal bounce target, and miss it.
expect: First target takes 10 Cold before defenses. Doubles permit one jump at level 1. The second target takes no damage, and no third attack occurs.

setup: Put two creatures inside a 15-ft cone and one outside. Script failed and successful Constitution saves.
act: Cast, then finish the caster's next turn.
expect: Only the in-cone failure is Blinded. Remove that condition at the end of the caster's next turn. No scene-light emitter is created.

setup: Visible creature fails Wisdom. It holds two objects.
act: Choose Drop and advance to the target's turn.
expect: On its turn the creature drops both held objects and its turn ends. Objects do not drop during the caster's turn.

setup: Provide signed speech, a written page, and a cipher in an unfamiliar language.
act: Observe signs, touch the written page for a minute, and inspect the cipher.
expect: Reveal literal meaning of signing and the contacted page. The cipher remains undecoded.

setup: Open vessel with room for ten gallons, a closed vessel, and an active area of fog.
act: Create water in the open vessel, test the closed vessel, and separately use Destroy Water on a 30-ft cube of fog.
expect: Create up to ten gallons in the open vessel only. Remove fog in the selected cube without changing outside fog.

setup: Wounded touched creature with at least 20 missing HP. Caster modifier +3, all d8s roll 4.
act: Cast at levels 1 and 2 in separate runs.
expect: Restore 11 and 19 HP respectively. Spend the selected slot and clamp HP to maximum.

setup: A Fiend and active Hallow are within 30 ft. A second Fiend is behind a thin lead barrier.
act: Cast and inspect detection, then end concentration.
expect: Report the unblocked Fiend and Hallow locations, omit the blocked Fiend, and end spell-supplied detections when concentration ends.

setup: One visible creature has an Evocation effect. Another source is behind a lead sheet within 30 ft.
act: Cast and then take the Magic action to inspect auras.
expect: Initial result indicates an unblocked magical presence. The Magic action reveals the eligible visible aura and school, without revealing the lead-shielded source.

setup: Put an unblocked poison, a magical contagion, and a venomous creature behind one inch of metal within 30 ft.
act: Cast and request detections.
expect: Return the unblocked locations and kinds. The barrier excludes the creature.

setup: Caster selects a same-limbed apparent form one foot taller. A viewer can touch the apparent extra height.
act: Apply the disguise and examine its discrepancy.
expect: Appearance changes, physical dimensions and stats do not, and the false portion fails physical inspection.

setup: Visible target has an available reaction and two paths, one unsafe. All d6s roll 4.
act: Resolve a failed and a successful Wisdom save in separate runs.
expect: Failure takes 12 Psychic and consumes the target reaction to move along the safest available route. Success takes 6 and leaves position and reaction unchanged.

setup: Fix d4 to 3. Script a weapon hit, spell attack hit, and weapon miss.
act: Cast and resolve all three attacks, then expire the effect.
expect: Add 3 Radiant only on the weapon hit. After expiration subsequent weapon hits gain no rider.

setup: Script a qualifying melee hit against a Humanoid and an Undead in separate runs. Fix d8 to 4.
act: Accept the level-1 Smite prompt on each hit.
expect: Apply extra Radiant of 8 and 12 respectively, charge one selected slot and the Bonus Action per accepted cast.

setup: Use a Large target and scripted Strength rolls where both dice fail. Fix the periodic d6 at 4.
act: Cast on the triggering hit, start the target's turn, then have an adjacent ally succeed on the escape check.
expect: Roll the Large target save with Advantage, restrain on failure, apply 4 Piercing at turn start, then remove restraint on the ally's success.

setup: Caster and two creatures are in the 20-ft square. One creature fails Strength and the other succeeds.
act: Cast, have the failed target pass the Athletics escape check, then end concentration.
expect: Terrain becomes difficult. Only the failed creature is restrained, and its escape leaves terrain intact until concentration ends.

setup: Caster Speed 30 ft and an unspent Bonus Action.
act: Cast, advance a turn, and choose Dash again as a Bonus Action.
expect: Each accepted Dash increases that turn's movement budget by 30 ft. Later Dashes consume their own Bonus Action and do not spend another slot.

setup: Caster already has 9 temporary HP. Roll 3 on each d4.
act: Cast at level 1 and choose to accept the new pool.
expect: New temporary HP pool is 10, replacing 9 rather than stacking. Ordinary HP is unchanged.

setup: Six creatures fall simultaneously within range.
act: Use the reaction and select five. Land one selected creature before expiry.
expect: The five descend at 60 ft per round. The sixth falls normally. The landed creature takes no fall damage and its own effect ends.

setup: Choose a Cat spirit of Fey type and an unoccupied point. A second cast occurs with the familiar still present.
act: Summon, attempt an Attack action with the familiar, and recast choosing a different legal form.
expect: Create one familiar with the chosen form's stats and Fey type. Reject the Attack action. Recast changes form and does not create a second familiar.

setup: Create a disk on legal ground with 500 lb loaded.
act: Add one more pound.
expect: The disk holds the initial load. Exceeding the limit ends the spell and drops the load.

setup: Place a level-1 fog sphere then a level-2 sphere in separate scenes.
act: Inspect geometry, then disperse the cloud with a strong wind.
expect: Radiuses are 20 and 40 ft. The area is Heavily Obscured and clears when wind disperses it.

setup: A wounded creature holds one of the ten created berries.
act: Eat one as a Bonus Action, then advance 24 hours.
expect: Restore 1 HP and grant one day's nourishment, consume the berry, and remove leftovers at expiry.

setup: One creature begins on the chosen square and another enters later. Script failed Dexterity saves.
act: Cast and move the second creature into the square.
expect: Both triggers prompt saves and apply Prone on failure. The 10-ft square is difficult terrain and is nonflammable.

setup: Script a hit, all d6s roll 3, then schedule two attacks against the target before the caster's next turn ends.
act: Cast and resolve those attacks.
expect: Deal 12 Radiant before defenses. Only the first following attack gains Advantage from this cast.

setup: A visible ally is in range with at least 10 missing HP. Modifier +3 and each d4 rolls 3.
act: Cast as a Bonus Action at level 1.
expect: Restore 9 HP and consume the selected slot and Bonus Action.

setup: An eligible visible creature damages the caster. Fix d10s to 6.
act: Accept the reaction and test failure and success on Dexterity in separate runs.
expect: Apply 12 or 6 Fire before defenses and spend the reaction and slot once per accepted cast.

setup: Willing touched creature, caster modifier +3, and an enemy that would cause Frightened.
act: Cast and advance through the target's turn start, spend the gained buffer and advance again. End concentration.
expect: Grant Frightened immunity and 3 temporary HP each turn start without stacking. Expiry ends the immunity and future grants. Unspent temporary HP follows the normal temporary HP lifetime.

setup: Choose Strength on a visible target. Fix d6 to 4 and drop the target to 0 HP before the spell ends.
act: Hit the target, roll its Strength check and save, then transfer the curse as a Bonus Action on a later turn.
expect: Add 4 Necrotic on the hit. Only the check has Disadvantage. Transfer the existing curse without spending a new slot.

setup: Visible creature fails initial Wisdom save. On damage, the target succeeds only with the higher of two dice.
act: Apply the spell and then deal damage.
expect: Apply Prone and Incapacitated. Damage grants Advantage on the repeat save. Success ends the spell's conditions.

setup: Mark a visible creature and fix d6 to 4.
act: Hit it, make a Survival check to find it, then move the mark to a legal visible target after the original drops to 0 HP.
expect: Add 4 Force to the qualifying hit. Apply Advantage to the tracking check. Transfer costs a Bonus Action without charging another slot.

setup: Aim at a creature with two neighbors, one within 5 ft and one outside. Script the attack to miss and d6s to 4.
act: Explode the shard, scripting a failed save for the nearby creature.
expect: No Piercing damage is applied. Affected creatures still save. The failed nearby creature takes 8 Cold before defenses, and the outside one takes none.

setup: Provide a touched charged item requiring Attunement and a touched creature affected by a known spell.
act: Complete the casting on each separately.
expect: Reveal the item properties, attunement requirement and charges in the first run, and the spell affecting the creature in the second.

setup: Touched creature, two d10s roll 7.
act: Test a failed and a successful Constitution save.
expect: Apply 14 and 7 Necrotic before defenses, with no attack roll.

setup: Willing target with 20 ft of movement left and unobstructed landing.
act: Use the spell jump twice on one turn and again on its next turn.
expect: First jump can cover 30 ft for 10 ft of movement. A second spell jump that turn is unavailable. The per-turn use resets next turn.

setup: Target has 30-ft Speed.
act: Cast, advance one hour, and inspect current derived Speed.
expect: Speed rises to 40 ft and then returns to 30 ft at expiry.

setup: Willing unarmored target has Dexterity +3.
act: Cast, then equip armor.
expect: Base AC becomes 16 until the target equips armor, which ends the spell and restores normal AC derivation.

setup: Two visible creatures are in range and one has Shield already active. Fix d4 to 3.
act: Direct one dart at the Shield target and two at the other.
expect: The Shield target takes zero. Other target takes 8 Force total. All darts resolve simultaneously without attack rolls.

setup: Willing protected creature faces a Fiend and a Humanoid.
act: Attack with each and try to apply a new Charmed condition from the Fiend.
expect: Fiend attacks with Disadvantage and cannot Charm the target. The protection adds no penalty to the Humanoid attack.

setup: Put rotten nonmagical food and poisoned nonmagical drink inside the sphere, and an equivalent ration outside.
act: Cast at the legal point.
expect: Remove poison and rot from eligible food and drink inside. Preserve the ration outside.

setup: A ranged spell attack hits, with each d8 set to 5.
act: Resolve it, then advance through the end of the caster's next turn.
expect: Apply 10 Poison before defenses and Poisoned with no separate saving throw. Remove the condition at the stated boundary.

setup: Ward an ally. An attacker fails Wisdom, and a separate area spell also includes the ally.
act: Try the direct attack and then resolve the area. Have the warded ally make an attack.
expect: Retarget or lose the direct attack. The area affects the ally normally. The ally's attack ends the ward.

setup: Trigger with a qualifying hit. All d6s roll 4. Script failed Constitution then successful Constitution at successive turn starts.
act: Accept the smite and advance two target turns.
expect: Deal 4 extra Fire on the hit and 4 at each of those turn starts, before the respective save. Success ends future ticks.

setup: Caster AC 14 is hit by attack total 18. Reaction and level-1 slot are available.
act: Cast in response, then advance to the start of the caster's next turn.
expect: AC becomes 19 including against the trigger, so that attack misses. Restore AC 14 on the stated boundary.

setup: Target starts at AC 15.
act: Cast, then end concentration before natural expiry.
expect: AC becomes 17 and returns to 15 when concentration ends.

setup: Create a legal 15-ft image and offer a viewer physical interaction.
act: Move the image with the Magic action and have the viewer test it.
expect: Image changes position and can appear to move naturally. Physical interaction reveals the illusion to that viewer. No sound or smell is added.

setup: Two eligible creatures are selected in the sphere. One fails both Wisdom saves, the other fails first and succeeds second.
act: Advance their next turns, then damage the creature that failed twice.
expect: Apply Incapacitated after each initial failure. At the repeat save one becomes Unconscious and one recovers. Damage ends the remaining effect.

setup: Provide a Beast witness and a known nearby event it perceived that day.
act: Cast, communicate, and use an eligible Influence skill option.
expect: Allow verbal exchange and the Influence option. The witness can report the supplied event without gaining unrelated knowledge.

setup: In a 15-ft cube place two creatures and an unsecured object fully inside. Roll 4 on both d8s.
act: Script one failed and one successful Constitution save.
expect: Failure takes 8 Thunder and is pushed 10 ft. Success takes 4 and stays in place. The loose object is pushed 10 ft.

setup: Spawn the servant on unoccupied ground within range.
act: Command an eligible simple task, then try an attack command and deal 1 HP of damage.
expect: Allow the task, reject the attack, and end the spell at 0 HP.

setup: Target has Acid immunity. A level-2 cast hits and all d4s roll 3.
act: Apply the hit and advance through the end of the target's next turn.
expect: The attack resolves once and schedules its one delayed event. Immunity prevents the 12 initial and 6 delayed Acid damage. The event is consumed at its own boundary.

setup: Two wounded allies have current/max HP 9/16 and 18/20.
act: Cast with a level-3 slot and select both allies.
expect: The allies become 19/26 and 28/30 HP. Unselected allies are unchanged.

setup: Caster has Speed 30 ft and lacks a Swim Speed.
act: Select Aquatic Adaptation, then use a Magic action to switch to Change Appearance.
expect: First grant underwater breathing and 30-ft Swim Speed. Switching removes both grants, changes appearance within legal limits and retains one concentration effect.

setup: Visible Tiny Beasts of CR 0 and CR 1/8 are in range. Supply a visited location, recipient description and short message.
act: Cast separately, scripting a failed Charisma save for the CR 0 Beast.
expect: The CR 0 Beast attempts delivery. CR 1/8 automatically succeeds and does not receive a delivery task.

setup: A closed chest has one designated creature and a password.
act: Have an ordinary creature try to pick it, let the designated creature open it, then speak the password nearby.
expect: Nonmagical picking fails. The designated creature can open it. The password unlocks it for one minute.

setup: Touch a willing creature and choose Fiend for Mask.
act: Inspect an effect that detects creature type and a normal stat inspection.
expect: The qualifying detection treats it as Fiend. Its actual creature type, combat stats and ordinary sheet remain unchanged.

setup: First cast since the caster's long rest. Plan an action within 30 minutes and supply the omen Woe.
act: Cast with the legal components and apply the chosen omen.
expect: Return Woe to the caster. The first reading uses the supplied omen without a repeat-casting uncertainty roll.

setup: Two willing creatures have derived AC 14 and 18, respectively.
act: Cast separately, then expire the effects.
expect: The first becomes AC 17 and the second stays 18. Expiry restores ordinary AC derivation.

setup: Visible target fails initial Constitution, then succeeds at its turn end.
act: Choose Deafened and advance through its turn.
expect: Apply only Deafened until the successful repeat save.

setup: A Humanoid in the sphere is already Frightened, with duration remaining beyond this cast. A Beast is nearby.
act: Humanoid fails Charisma. Choose the suppression branch, then end concentration.
expect: Suppress Frightened on the Humanoid, leave the Beast unaffected and restore the prior condition if its own lifetime remains.

setup: One language-using creature is within 30 ft unobstructed. Another nearby creature uses neither language nor telepathy.
act: Use Sense Thoughts.
expect: Report the presence of a qualifying mind without revealing the content of its thoughts. The second creature adds no detection.

setup: A willing ally gains Cold breath. Two targets are in its cone. All d6s roll 4.
act: Ally uses the granted Magic action with failed and successful Dexterity saves.
expect: Deal 12 and 6 Cold before defenses. Charge no new spell slot for the exhalation.

setup: Select Dexterity on a touched ally.
act: Make Stealth and Athletics checks, a Dexterity saving throw and a Dexterity attack roll.
expect: Only the Dexterity ability check gains Advantage from this effect.

setup: A Medium willing creature carries equipment. A separate unwilling creature passes Constitution.
act: Enlarge each in independent runs.
expect: Willing creature and its equipment enlarge, with the creature becoming Large. Successful unwilling target and its gear remain unchanged.

setup: Two visible creatures in range, one already fighting the caster's group. The other fails Wisdom.
act: Cast, then inspect both targets' Perception.
expect: Fighting target automatically succeeds. Other target loses 10 from Wisdom (Perception) checks and Passive Perception for the duration.

setup: The caster already has a steed from the spell and chooses a new legal unoccupied point.
act: Cast and choose the new steed's legal form and type.
expect: Replace the previous steed with one instance using the Otherworldly Steed stat block. Preserve the chosen appearance and creature type.

setup: A mechanical pit and a naturally weak floor are both in line of sight within range.
act: Cast and inspect the result.
expect: Report the presence and general nature of danger of the designed trap without its exact location. The natural weak floor is excluded.

setup: A touched corpse has spent two days counting against a resurrection deadline.
act: Apply the spell and advance three days before expiry.
expect: The corpse does not decay or become Undead during that time. Its elapsed time for the deadline stays at two days.

setup: Two creatures begin in a legal 60-by-10-ft line, one fails Strength and one succeeds. Fog is in the line.
act: Cast, then move a creature 10 ft toward the caster in the line.
expect: Failure moves 15 ft away along the line and success is not pushed. Moving toward the caster costs 20 ft. The strong wind disperses qualifying fog.

setup: A visible manufactured metal weapon is held by a creature. Set each d8 to 4 and Constitution save to fail.
act: Cast and resolve contact and the drop effect.
expect: Deal 8 Fire before defenses to the contacting creature. It drops the weapon if it can. A later tick affects only creatures still in contact.

setup: A visible Humanoid fails initial Wisdom but succeeds on the end-of-turn save. A Beast is also visible.
act: Cast on the Humanoid and attempt a separate cast on the Beast.
expect: Humanoid becomes Paralyzed until the successful save. Beast is ineligible.

setup: A touched ally is Invisible from the spell and has a scripted attack miss.
act: Make the attack roll.
expect: The spell remains active until the attack roll and ends immediately after the roll, even though the attack missed.

setup: A closed chest has two mundane locks. A separate door is under Arcane Lock.
act: Cast once per object in separate runs.
expect: Unlock one chest lock only. Suppress Arcane Lock on the door for 10 minutes. Both castings emit the prescribed audible knock.

setup: A creature is Poisoned, Blinded and Frightened.
act: Choose Poisoned.
expect: Remove Poisoned only. Blinded and Frightened persist.

setup: A loose 500-lb object has 20 ft of clear vertical room. An otherwise identical object weighs 501 lb.
act: Choose a 20-ft ascent and test each weight separately.
expect: Suspend the 500-lb object 20 ft up. Reject the overweight object without changing its position.

setup: A matching plant is 3 miles north and a second is 4 miles east. A different species is closer.
act: Request the matching kind.
expect: Return the direction and distance to the plant 3 miles north, ignoring the closer wrong kind.

setup: A familiar moving object is 800 ft away. Repeat with a continuous lead barrier on the direct path.
act: Cast and inspect results.
expect: Without lead, report direction to the object and its movement direction. With lead, the spell cannot locate it.

setup: An eligible unattended visible object receives a five-word message and a qualifying visible trigger within 30 ft.
act: Cause a nonmatching event, then the trigger.
expect: The object stays quiet for the first event and speaks the supplied message for the qualifying event.

setup: Two nonmagical weapons have no enhancement bonuses.
act: Cast with a level-2 slot on the first, then recast on the second.
expect: First gains magic status and +1 to attack and damage, then loses both when the second gains them. One cast remains active.

setup: Target fails Wisdom and three d8s roll 4. It later becomes Invisible and then changes plane.
act: Cast and inspect tracking after each change.
expect: Apply 12 Psychic before defenses. Same-plane location remains known despite Invisibility. The spell grants no location on a different plane.

setup: Two visible legal-size spaces are 25 ft away, one occupied and one empty.
act: Select each in independent runs.
expect: Empty space permits teleportation directly to it. Occupied space is ineligible. The teleport traverses no intermediate squares.

setup: A selected ally starts inside the 30-ft emanation and then exits it.
act: Make Stealth checks and inspect tracks inside and outside.
expect: Inside, gain +10 to Stealth and leave no tracks. Outside, neither ongoing benefit applies.

setup: Target fails Intelligence. The phantasm is an eligible hostile creature within the allowed geometry. Set d6 to 4.
act: Start a qualifying damage turn, then have the target succeed on its Investigation check.
expect: Only the target perceives it, and qualifying damage is 4 Psychic. Successful examination ends the illusion and future damage.

setup: Two wounded allies are chosen. Only one remains in range throughout casting. Set both d8s to 4.
act: Complete casting, then repeat before the first ally's Long Rest.
expect: Eligible ally receives Short Rest benefits and 8 HP up to maximum. Departed ally does not. The first ally cannot benefit from another cast before a Long Rest.

setup: Touched creature is Poisoned. Later it faces another Poisoned save and 12 Poison damage.
act: Cast and resolve both events within the duration.
expect: End current Poisoned, grant Advantage on the new save and reduce 12 Poison damage to 6 from Resistance.

setup: Two separate targets make Constitution saves, one success and one failure.
act: Check their next attacks and make Strength and Dexterity ability checks.
expect: Success imposes Disadvantage on the next attack within its shorter window. Failure imposes Disadvantage on Strength D20 Tests during the effect and does not penalize a Dexterity ability check.

setup: Cast with a legal rope below a ceiling. One creature climbs in and another stays outside.
act: Try an attack across the portal. Then allow the spell to expire.
expect: Prevent the cross-portal attack. At expiry, occupants and objects in the space fall out, and the entrance disappears.

setup: Three rays have results hit, miss, hit. Set each d6 to 4. Split between two targets.
act: Allocate one ray to A and two to B, then resolve independently.
expect: A takes 8 Fire before defenses. B takes 8 from its one hit, with no damage from the missed ray.

setup: A Construct and a loose nonmagical object are in the sphere. The Construct would pass only with its higher die. Three d8s roll 4.
act: Cast and resolve the sphere.
expect: Construct rolls Constitution with Disadvantage and takes 12 Thunder before defenses. Loose nonmagical object also takes 12.

setup: One creature is entirely inside the sphere. Another is outside. Both face 10 Thunder damage and have a Verbal spell available.
act: Try casting and resolve Thunder damage in each location.
expect: Inside creature is Deafened, cannot cast with Verbal components and takes no Thunder damage. Outside creature has none of these spell effects.

setup: Willing target has 30-ft Speed and both hands occupied.
act: Cast and use the granted movement on a wall and ceiling, then end concentration.
expect: Grant 30-ft Climb Speed and legal hands-free climbing, including the ceiling. Both grants end with the spell.

setup: A creature moves 10 ft along a legal path inside the area. All d4s roll 3.
act: Move using its normal movement budget.
expect: Difficult terrain charges 20 ft of movement and two 5-ft hazard intervals deal 12 Piercing before defenses.

setup: Caster modifier +3. Force appears adjacent to a valid target. Roll a hit and 5 on d8.
act: Resolve the first attack and later spend a Bonus Action on a legal move and hit with the same die.
expect: Each hit deals 8 Force before defenses. The second attack spends the Bonus Action without a second slot. Ending concentration removes the force.

setup: A creature can hear and understand. Provide an achievable suggestion under 25 words and a separate obviously harmful suggestion.
act: Submit both suggestions separately and script failed Wisdom for the valid one.
expect: The legal failed-save suggestion applies Charmed and the supplied activity. The harmful suggestion is ineligible.

setup: Caster and willing target are 30 ft apart with no other modifiers. Both wear legal components. Target takes 12 incoming damage.
act: Resolve damage, then separate them beyond 60 ft.
expect: While linked the target has +1 AC and saves, takes 6 after Resistance, and caster takes 6 from the link. Beyond 60 ft the link ends.

setup: Place an unanchored cube with no supporting floor, wall or ceiling.
act: Cast, allow one round to pass, and inspect area and concentration.
expect: The unsupported web collapses after one round and its difficult terrain and obscurement end.

setup: Two creatures enter a legal radius, one passing and one failing Charisma.
act: Ask both a question and attempt deliberate lies, then move the failed creature outside.
expect: Caster knows both save outcomes. Inside, the failed creature cannot deliberately lie but can refuse or evade. Outside, that restriction no longer applies.

setup: A pile of bones and the corpse of a Medium Humanoid are in range. Start with no existing undead under control.
act: Cast separately on each with a level-3 slot and issue a legal command on the caster's turn.
expect: Bones create a Skeleton and corpse creates a Zombie. Only the created undead receives the command. The command spends a Bonus Action without a new slot.

setup: Two selected creatures are wounded. One later receives 2d8 + 3 healing.
act: Cast, resolve healing and roll a Wisdom and Death Saving Throw for eligible targets.
expect: Healing restores up to 19 HP without rolling the healing dice. The two specified save types have Advantage during the effect.

setup: Touched creature fails Wisdom. Choose Strength for the ability branch.
act: Check a Strength ability check, Strength save and Dexterity save, then remove the curse.
expect: The first two have Disadvantage and Dexterity does not. Removing the curse clears both affected modifiers.

setup: Caster is on the Material Plane. Script successive end-of-turn d6 results 3 and 4. An unoccupied visible return space is within 10 ft.
act: Advance two turn ends and then the caster's next turn start.
expect: Roll 3 leaves the caster in place. Roll 4 moves them to the Ethereal Plane. They return to the selected legal space at the next start.

setup: A legal storm-cloud cylinder fits. Two creatures are within 5 ft of the chosen strike point. No preexisting storm. All d10s roll 4.
act: Strike with one failed and one successful Dexterity save.
expect: Deal 12 and 6 Lightning before defenses. A later eligible Magic action can strike again without a new slot.

setup: Place the Large spectral pack, with caster within 5 ft and a visible enemy that both enters and ends its turn in reach. All d10s roll 4.
act: Resolve entry, end of turn, and caster's Strength save.
expect: Enemy saves once that turn and takes 12 Slashing on failure. Caster has Advantage on the Strength save.

setup: A creature visibly casts an eligible spell without a spell slot. Script its failed Constitution save.
act: Accept the reaction.
expect: The triggering spell fails and its triggering action is spent. The Counterspell caster spends the selected slot and reaction. No slot refund is created for the original caster.

setup: Choose empty containers in range and a legal ordinary food appearance.
act: Cast and advance 24 hours.
expect: Create 45 lb of nourishing food and 30 gallons of clean water. The food spoils at the stated time and the water remains clean.

setup: One target has ongoing level-3, level-4 and level-5 spell effects. Check totals are 14 against the level-4 effect and 14 against the level-5 effect.
act: Cast at level 3 and resolve each effect.
expect: End level 3 automatically and level 4 after meeting DC 14. Level 5 remains because DC 15 is missed.

setup: Two creatures holding objects are inside a 30-ft cone. One fails Wisdom and one succeeds.
act: Cast and advance the failed creature's turn with an available safe retreat.
expect: Only the failed creature drops what it holds, becomes Frightened and uses Dash to retreat by the safe route.

setup: Legal burst includes a loose flammable object and a flammable item carried by a creature.
act: Resolve the spell.
expect: The loose object ignites. The carried item is excluded from ignition by this spell's object rider.

setup: Willing target is grounded with no other flight capability.
act: Cast, move and hover aloft, then end concentration.
expect: Target gains a 60-ft Fly Speed and can hover. Losing the spell while aloft removes both and initiates falling.

setup: A willing target holds an item and is wearing armor. A narrow opening and an enemy are nearby.
act: Transform, try an attack and object manipulation, then move through the opening.
expect: Only 10-ft hovering flight applies. Attacking and manipulating the item are unavailable. The target can pass the narrow opening and retains its merged inventory.

setup: Inscribed glyph is inside a portable chest. Set a legal trigger and leave it dormant.
act: Move the chest 11 ft from its casting spot, then cause the former trigger.
expect: The glyph breaks on relocation, without triggering. The former trigger produces no glyph effect.

setup: A willing creature with AC 15 and Speed 30 ft receives the spell.
act: Inspect stats, try to use the extra action for Magic, and end concentration.
expect: Speed 60, AC 17 and Dexterity save Advantage while active. The extra action cannot be Magic. On expiry the stated lethargy prevents movement and actions until after its next turn.

setup: Two creatures are in the cube, but only one sees the pattern. Fix its failed Wisdom save.
act: Cast and then damage the affected creature.
expect: Only the viewer saves. Failure grants Charmed, Incapacitated and Speed 0. Damage ends that creature's effect.

setup: Two targets stand in the 100-by-5-ft line and another just outside. All d6s roll 4.
act: Cast and script one failed and one successful Dexterity save in the line.
expect: Deal 32 and 16 Lightning before defenses. Outside target is unaffected.

setup: Circle selects Fiends in its ordinary orientation. A Fiend outside approaches by normal movement.
act: Attempt to enter, then have a Humanoid attempt the same.
expect: Fiend cannot willingly enter by nonmagical movement. Humanoid is unrestricted by the chosen type.

setup: Create a legal image with sound and smell. A creature physically examines it.
act: Have that creature pass an object through the image.
expect: The examination reveals the illusion. The creature can see through it and its other sensory qualities become faint to that creature.

setup: Seven visible wounded allies in range, modifier +3 and d4s both 3.
act: Choose six and cast at level 3.
expect: Each selected ally heals up to 9 HP. Seventh ally is unchanged. Spend one Bonus Action and selected slot.

setup: A touched stone surface can fully contain the caster and inventory.
act: Merge and later exit through the entry point.
expect: Caster and equipment occupy the stone while merged, and exit at the entry point. Inventory is preserved.

setup: A willing protected target and an unprotected comparison target are legal for a Divination spell absent the ward.
act: Try direct Divination targeting and observation through a magical scrying sensor.
expect: Both protected routes are blocked for the warded creature. The comparison creature remains observable under the original conditions.

setup: Summon in a legal unoccupied ground space, then give one rider permission and deal damage to the steed.
act: Inspect movement and advance the one-minute fading interval.
expect: Steed has 100-ft Speed and its printed travel rate. Damage starts fading and allows one minute to dismount before disappearance.

setup: A chosen point has normal plants, including a path the caster excludes.
act: Use Overgrowth and move along affected and excluded routes.
expect: Each 1 ft of affected travel costs 4 ft of movement. Excluded path retains its prior movement cost.

setup: Choose Cold for a willing target with no other defenses.
act: Deal separate 12-point Cold and Fire hits during the effect.
expect: Cold becomes 6 through Resistance. Fire stays 12.

setup: A creature bears a curse and is attuned to a cursed magic item that it cannot remove.
act: Cast on the item, then separately cast on the creature.
expect: The item cast breaks its Attunement and allows removal while preserving its curse. The creature cast ends curses affecting that creature.

setup: Touch one creature dead from injury for 30 seconds and another dead of old age. Provide required components.
act: Cast separately.
expect: The injury target returns at 1 HP without restoring missing body parts. Old age is ineligible.

setup: Known recipient on the same plane and a valid message under 25 words.
act: Deliver, let the recipient block the caster, then send again within 8 hours.
expect: Initial message is delivered privately with the option to reply. Second fails and reports the block to the caster.

setup: A concentrating creature enters the cylinder and fails Dexterity. Another remains outside.
act: Resolve movement and inspect the cylinder.
expect: Failed entrant falls Prone and loses Concentration. Ground inside is difficult and Heavily Obscured. Outside creature has no entry save.

setup: Target has AC 16 and Speed 30 ft. It fails Wisdom then succeeds at the end of its turn.
act: Apply Slow and attempt a reaction during the effect.
expect: AC 14 and Speed 15, with no reactions. Successful repeat save removes those constraints and restores AC and Speed.

setup: Eligible corpse has a mouth, was not Undead and was not recently targeted. Provide facts it knew in life.
act: Ask up to five questions and then attempt a sixth.
expect: Permit no more than five answers from the spell, based on the corpse's knowledge. The sixth receives no spell response.

setup: A plant in the immobile emanation witnessed an event within the past day. Provide that fact to the storyteller.
act: Cast and ask the plant about the event.
expect: Enable communication and return the supplied observation. Moving the caster does not move the affected emanation.

setup: A Good caster exempts one ally. One enemy both enters the emanation and ends its turn there. All d8s roll 4.
act: Script failed Wisdom and resolve both triggers.
expect: Enemy saves once on that turn and takes 12 Radiant before defenses, with halved Speed inside. Exempt ally is unaffected.

setup: A creature starts its turn in the cloud and fails Constitution. The cloud is later hit by strong wind.
act: Resolve the start and advance through its turn, then apply wind.
expect: Failed creature becomes Poisoned and cannot take an action or Bonus Action for that turn. Turn end removes its condition, and wind disperses the cloud.

setup: All intended occupants fit within the 10-ft emanation. An outsider approaches and one original occupant leaves and reenters.
act: Resolve entry attempts, then move the caster out.
expect: Original occupant can reenter and outsider is barred. When the caster leaves, the effect ends.

setup: Touched creature does not know a language another creature uses to sign. The second creature knows at least one language.
act: Exchange signed messages during the effect.
expect: Target understands the incoming signing and its outgoing signing is understood by the eligible recipient. No permanent language proficiency is granted.

setup: A wounded caster hits a target with Necrotic Resistance. All d6s roll 4.
act: Resolve hit and the resulting healing.
expect: Target takes 6 Necrotic after Resistance. Caster regains 3 HP.

setup: Ten willing creatures and an unwilling eleventh are in range.
act: Select the willing targets and submerge them, then return them to air.
expect: All selected targets can breathe underwater and retain their normal respiration. Unwilling creature gains nothing.

setup: A willing creature is underwater and a separate willing creature is near molten lava.
act: Cast on both.
expect: Submerged target rises toward the surface at the spell's rate. Lava can support the eligible movement but still poses heat damage.

setup: Create a legal continuous wall with a creature in its area. All d8s roll 4. Another creature fires a normal arrow through it.
act: Script the affected creature's failed Strength save and resolve the arrow.
expect: Initial damage is 16 Bludgeoning before defenses. The arrow misses automatically.

setup: Choose a familiar legal location and hearing mode. Bonus Action is available.
act: Cast then switch to sight as Bonus Action.
expect: Create an intangible stationary sensor feeding only caster. Switch replaces hearing with sight, keeping one sensor and concentration. The visible-orb description defines appearance rather than an illumination radius.

setup: An allied creature at 0 HP starts in the 30-ft emanation. Another ally in it suffers 12 Necrotic damage.
act: Start the dying ally's turn and resolve the other damage.
expect: First ally regains 1 HP. Second takes 6 after Resistance. A reduction of either ally's HP maximum is prevented while inside.

setup: A visible Fiend fails Charisma. Concentration is maintained for one full minute.
act: Advance to expiry, then repeat with concentration broken early.
expect: The full-minute Fiend remains away. Early ending returns it to its former space or nearest unoccupied space and removes Incapacitated.

setup: A creature fails Strength when the square appears and also ends its turn there. All d6s roll 4.
act: Resolve appearance and end of turn on the same turn.
expect: It takes 12 Bludgeoning and becomes Restrained. It makes this spell's save only once on that turn. Terrain stays difficult.

setup: Target a Plant creature, an ordinary creature passing Constitution and a nonmagical shrub separately. Each d8 rolls 4.
act: Cast once per target.
expect: Plant automatically fails and takes 32 Necrotic before defenses. Successful ordinary creature takes 16. Shrub withers without a save.

setup: A visible non-Humanoid creature is not fighting the party and fails Wisdom.
act: Cast and then damage it with an ally.
expect: It becomes Charmed and Friendly to caster. Allied damage ends the effect and target knows it was charmed.

setup: A visible creature fails Wisdom. A safe eastward route exists.
act: Spend a later Bonus Action designating east and advance its turn.
expect: It moves as far east as possible by a safe route, then repeats the save. A success ends its own Charmed effect.

setup: Two creatures fail initial Wisdom. Fix their next turn-start d10 rolls to 9 and 10.
act: Advance their turns.
expect: Both can act and move normally for those turns under the table, while their spell remains active until expiry or successful end-of-turn save.

setup: Caster attacks a creature in the emanation and one outside. All rider d8s roll 4; choose Cold.
act: Resolve hits against both.
expect: Inside hit gains 8 Cold before defenses. Outside hit gains none. Enemies treat the emanation's ground as difficult terrain.

setup: Enemy enters and ends its turn in the 10-ft emanation. All d8s roll 4 and Wisdom fails.
act: Resolve both triggers in that turn.
expect: One save and 20 Force before defenses for that turn, rather than two ticks. Later turns can trigger again.

setup: Choose a 100-ft cube containing standing water.
act: Use Flood to raise its level by 20 ft, then end the effect.
expect: Only chosen water changes under the selected effect. When Flood ends the standing water returns to its normal level.

setup: Target has 7 HP and receives 10 damage after defenses. Run a separate instant-death effect without damage.
act: Apply each in an independent run.
expect: Damage run ends at 1 HP and consumes the ward. Instant-death run negates that effect and consumes the ward without changing HP.

setup: A willing companion stands 4 ft away and the destination is empty.
act: Teleport 400 ft to a described destination.
expect: Caster and companion arrive in legal spaces within 5 ft of one another. The teleport crosses no intermediate locations.

setup: First reading since Long Rest. Supply a truthful answer about a stated event in 6 days.
act: Cast with required components.
expect: Return the supplied answer and charge required resources once. No repeat-casting uncertainty applies to this first reading.

setup: A visible Beast fails Wisdom while not fighting the party, then succeeds after damage.
act: Issue a legal telepathic command and resolve damage.
expect: The Beast is Charmed and follows the command while linked on the same plane. Successful damage save ends domination.

setup: Enough timber for a simple Large bridge is visible. No creatures occupy the material.
act: Complete casting to form the bridge.
expect: Consume the chosen timber and create one bridge within the printed volume. Do not create extra material or magical properties.

setup: Target has Speed 30, faces difficult terrain, and is nonmagically Grappled.
act: Cast and spend 5 ft to escape.
expect: Ignore difficult terrain and gain Swim Speed 30. Five feet of movement ends the nonmagical restraint automatically.

setup: Choose Spider and a legal unoccupied space.
act: Summon and advance combat initiative, then end concentration.
expect: Create one ally using the Spider variant of the Giant Insect stat block. It acts immediately after caster on the same initiative count and disappears with concentration.

setup: Touched ally attacks and deals damage during the spell.
act: Resolve the attack then end concentration.
expect: The attack does not end this version of Invisible. Concentration ending removes it.

setup: An enemy enters guardian range on three separate turns and fails each Dexterity save. No Radiant defenses.
act: Resolve the three triggers.
expect: Each deals 20 Radiant. After 60 total damage the guardian vanishes and cannot trigger again.

setup: A road appears to be a swamp; its actual terrain is normal. A manufactured bridge is in the cube.
act: Apply the illusion and walk across it.
expect: Appearance, sound and smell change for natural terrain. Physical travel costs remain those of the real road. The bridge's appearance remains unchanged.

setup: All d10s and d6s roll 4. One target fails Dexterity and another succeeds.
act: Cast, then end caster's next turn.
expect: Failure takes 8 Bludgeoning and 16 Cold before defenses. Success takes 4 and 8. Hail's difficult terrain ends at the stated boundary.

setup: Familiar creature is moving 800 ft away. Repeat with running water 10 ft wide blocking the direct path.
act: Cast and inspect direction results.
expect: First run provides direction and movement direction. Running water blocks location in the second run.

setup: Target fails initial Wisdom, all d10s roll 4, then succeeds at end of its turn.
act: Apply and advance that turn.
expect: Initial damage is 16 Psychic before defenses and checks/attacks have Disadvantage. Successful repeat save ends the spell without another failed-save tick.

setup: A level-4 character fails Wisdom and chosen Beast is CR 1. Chosen Beast form has 20 HP.
act: Transform and deal 7 damage that reduces only the spell's temporary HP.
expect: Apply the chosen form and its temporary HP. Track those HP separately from original HP and obey reversion when that buffer is lost.

setup: Choose a cube with teleportation and planar-travel blocks only.
act: Attempt a teleport across its boundary and ordinary walking through the same boundary.
expect: Teleport and planar travel are blocked. Walking remains permitted. No unselected sound or sight barrier is created.

setup: A Medium target fails Dexterity and is enclosed.
act: Resolve an external attack and the target pushing the sphere.
expect: External effect cannot damage the occupant. Occupant can roll the sphere using its allowed movement interaction.

setup: A legal chest contains 8 cubic ft of nonliving goods; caster touches it and its replica.
act: Cast, then use a Magic action while touching replica to recall.
expect: Chest and contents move to the Ethereal Plane, then return to an unoccupied ground space within 5 ft of caster.

setup: A 5-ft-thick stone wall and a legal passage shape are selected.
act: Touch wall and shape the passage.
expect: Create that opening within the volume limit. New passage changes collision geometry while preserving stone outside the selected volume.

setup: Willing touched ally has no other defenses and faces 12 Slashing, 12 Piercing, 12 Bludgeoning and 12 Fire.
act: Cast and resolve damage.
expect: Each physical type is reduced to 6. Fire stays 12, including if the physical attacks are magical.

setup: All d4s roll 3. One target fails Dexterity and another succeeds.
act: Cast and finish each target's next turn.
expect: Failure takes 30 Acid initially and 15 later. Success takes 15 initially and no delayed damage, all before defenses.

setup: Create a legal opaque wall and choose its damaging side. All d8s roll 4.
act: Fail one initial Dexterity save; on a later turn end another creature within 10 ft on the damaging side.
expect: Initial failure takes 20 Fire. Later qualifying end takes 20 Fire without a save. The opposite side does not apply that proximity damage.

setup: Caster modifier +4. Select one Huge and one Small unattended nonmagical object, plus a worn item.
act: Complete casting and command the legal objects.
expect: Huge counts as three and Small as one, filling the four-object allowance. Worn item is ineligible. Animated objects use the matching sizes of the spell's stat block.

setup: A Beast and an Undead approach the caster's 10-ft barrier.
act: Try entry, then move the caster so the Beast would be forced through.
expect: Beast cannot voluntarily pass or reach through; Undead is exempt. Forcing the Beast through by moving the aura ends the spell.

setup: Caster HP maximum is 40 and a Large hand appears at a legal point.
act: Deal 39 damage to the hand and then 1 more.
expect: The hand has AC 20 and 40 HP. It persists at 1 HP and disappears at 0, ending the spell.

setup: Touched Beast has Intelligence 2. Caster knows Common.
act: Complete casting with the consumed component and choose Common.
expect: Beast gains Intelligence 10 and Common. Track the spell's 30-day Charmed duration separately from its enduring changes.

setup: All d8s roll 4. One creature fails initial Constitution, then remains for its next turn. A second succeeds.
act: Resolve initial burst and the later qualifying trigger.
expect: Failure takes 20 Poison before defenses and success 10. Track the once-per-turn limit, fog movement and strong-wind removal.

setup: First casting since Long Rest. Supply truthful responses yes, no and unclear.
act: Ask three questions and attempt a fourth during the same cast.
expect: Return the three supplied responses and no fourth answer. No repeated-casting failure chance applies on the first cast.

setup: Caster is outdoors, with known terrain, local creature presence and planar influence within 3 miles.
act: Select three eligible fact categories.
expect: Return supplied facts for the 3-mile area. The same spell inside a constructed settlement fails to function.

setup: Two creatures in the 60-ft cone fail and succeed Constitution. All d8s roll 4.
act: Apply spell and separately kill a target with it.
expect: Damage is 32 and 16 Cold before defenses. A creature killed by the spell becomes a frozen statue until thawed.

setup: Choose water spirit. An enemy enters it and fails its save. All d8s roll 4.
act: Fail entry Dexterity, fail the next turn-start repeat, then succeed a later repeat.
expect: Entry deals 32 Cold and Restrained. Failed turn-start repeat deals 16 Cold. Successful repeat removes that restraint without ending the spirit. An already restraining spirit cannot seize another target.

setup: Caster's Intelligence save total is 15 and five answers are supplied.
act: Cast, ask five questions, then try a sixth.
expect: Success allows five one-word answers within the spell duration. A sixth is unavailable.

setup: Target fails initial Constitution. All eleven d8s roll 4. Choose Dexterity, then script three successful end-of-turn Constitution saves.
act: Resolve casting and repeat saves.
expect: Deal 44 Necrotic before defenses, apply Poisoned and Disadvantage on Dexterity saves while Poisoned. Third successful repeat ends the spell.

setup: Select a previously seen wooden chair fitting a 5-ft cube.
act: Create the chair and advance one day.
expect: The vegetable-matter object exists for one day then disappears. Using spell-created material as another spell's Material component makes that casting fail.

setup: Caster touches an ally Charmed by a Fiend and also affected by an unrelated modifier.
act: Use Break Enchantment as a Magic action.
expect: End that Fiend-sourced Charmed effect and end this spell. Preserve the unrelated modifier.

setup: Visible Humanoid fails Wisdom while not fighting the party.
act: Give a same-plane telepathic command, then damage it and script a successful repeat save.
expect: It follows the command while Charmed. The successful damage save ends this spell and its control link.

setup: Known target is sleeping on the same plane. Willing messenger enters trance.
act: Use the conversational dream form and end the messenger's trance.
expect: Messenger becomes Incapacitated with Speed 0 during trance. Supplied conversation is delivered in the dream; ending trance removes both constraints.

setup: A target fails Dexterity and has Fire Resistance only. All ten d6s roll 4.
act: Apply the cylinder's damage.
expect: Deal 10 Fire after Resistance and 20 Radiant, for 30 total HP lost.

setup: Creature understands the command and fails Wisdom. All d10s roll 4.
act: Have it violate the command twice on the same day, then once on a later day.
expect: Each first violation for that day deals 20 Psychic before defenses. A second same-day violation causes no extra Geas damage.

setup: Target has two Exhaustion levels and an independent Poisoned condition.
act: Choose to remove one Exhaustion level.
expect: Reduce Exhaustion to one and preserve Poisoned. Consume the required component and selected slot once.

setup: Select a valid radius with no overlapping Hallow. Choose Fiends for ward and a supported extra-effect option.
act: Complete casting and have a Fiend approach.
expect: The Fiend cannot willingly enter. Record the chosen extra effect and affected group. Existing overlapping Hallow would invalidate this cast.

setup: A visible Beast fails Wisdom and succeeds at its next turn end.
act: Cast and advance through its turn.
expect: Paralyzed lasts until the successful repeat save. Target eligibility is not restricted to Humanoids.

setup: One creature fails initial Constitution and later enters again on that same turn. All d10s roll 4.
act: Resolve both events and end concentration.
expect: One save for that turn, dealing 16 Piercing before defenses. Light obscurement and difficult terrain end with the area.

setup: Supply a famous object's known and secret lore and an unrelated mundane object.
act: Cast on the famous object and separately try the mundane one.
expect: Receive the storyteller-supplied lore for the famous object. Insufficient fame returns no lore.

setup: Choose six wounded creatures in the sphere; modifier +3 and each d8 is 4.
act: Cast and also inspect an unselected seventh creature.
expect: Each selected target heals up to 23 HP and the seventh is unchanged.

setup: Caster creates the double and gains Invisible, then makes an attack roll.
act: Resolve that roll and command the double with a later Magic action.
expect: Attack ends only the spell's invisibility. Double remains for the duration and obeys its movement/action rules.

setup: Target fails Wisdom, then receives damage while the caster is still describing the new memory.
act: Apply damage before modification completes.
expect: The spell ends immediately and no completed memory replacement is recorded.

setup: Create a passage within the 5-by-8-by-20-ft limits through stone. A creature stays inside it.
act: End the spell.
expect: Opening disappears and the creature is safely ejected to the nearest unoccupied space.

setup: A trapped Fiend remains in range for the entire casting and fails final Charisma.
act: Bind and issue a legal task.
expect: Record the service obligation for the spell duration, with the target following the best of its ability and no silently gained permanent ownership.

setup: A creature died from injury 5 days ago with required body parts intact. Provide consumed component.
act: Complete casting and then finish successive Long Rests.
expect: Return it with 1 HP and the printed -4 penalty. Reduce that penalty by 1 per Long Rest until it ends.

setup: An eligible Humanoid died 2 days ago. Fix the species d10 to 3.
act: Complete casting with legal components.
expect: Create a Dwarf body, preserving identity and memories and replacing species traits. Revalidate deferred grants and choices for the new species.

setup: Same-plane target fails its modified Wisdom save and later moves.
act: Cast and observe the sensor's view, then end concentration.
expect: Sensor follows within the spell's distance and shares its allowed sight and hearing with caster. Feed ends with concentration; unrelated observers gain no feed.

setup: Two visible targets, one willing and one unwilling who passes Charisma.
act: Apply distinct appearances.
expect: Only willing target is altered. Illusion changes appearance without changing real stats, size or equipment.

setup: Choose legal form and damage type, with required component and unoccupied space.
act: Summon, command and advance initiative; then reduce spirit to 0 HP.
expect: Use the Draconic Spirit stat block and slot scaling. Spirit acts immediately after caster, obeys verbal commands without caster action and disappears at 0 HP.

setup: An eligible visible loose object weighs 500 lb and a prior target is held by this casting.
act: Switch focus to the loose object and move it legally.
expect: Prior target is released. New object moves under the spell and no second simultaneous target is retained.

setup: Eight willing language-using creatures are linked; two share no language. A ninth knows none.
act: Cast and separate one participant onto another plane.
expect: All eight can initially communicate mentally over any same-plane distance. The language-less ninth is ineligible and the other-plane participant loses cross-plane communication.

setup: Known permanent destination circle is on the same plane.
act: Complete the circle and enter before end of caster's next turn, then attempt entry after that boundary.
expect: First entrant arrives at the destination or nearest available space under the spell. Portal is gone after the boundary and permits no later transit.

setup: Caster can enter two living trees of the same kind and sufficient size, 400 ft apart.
act: Spend 5 ft to enter and choose the second tree.
expect: Move between those trees as part of that move. A dead tree or one of a different kind is ineligible.

setup: Create contiguous legal panels across a passage. One target attacks the wall and another attempts to walk through.
act: Resolve both and cast Disintegrate on the wall separately.
expect: Wall blocks ordinary physical passage and is immune to damage. Disintegrate destroys it immediately.

setup: Create supported contiguous panels without enclosing creatures. Maintain concentration for ten minutes.
act: Complete duration and then end concentration.
expect: Stone becomes permanent, ceasing dependence on concentration. Ending concentration earlier would remove the wall.

setup: A creature enters the blade wall then ends its turn there on the same turn. Six d10s roll 4 and Dexterity fails.
act: Resolve both triggers.
expect: Apply 24 Force before defenses only once on that turn. The area is difficult terrain and wall provides the printed cover.

setup: Initial target and three secondary targets are legal; fourth potential secondary is 35 ft from first. All d8s roll 4.
act: Choose three secondaries and resolve failed and successful Dexterity saves.
expect: Each failed target takes 40 Lightning before defenses and each success 20. The too-distant secondary is ineligible and a target cannot be struck twice.

setup: Two targets in the sphere fail and succeed Constitution. Each d8 rolls 4.
act: Cast.
expect: Apply 32 and 16 Necrotic before defenses respectively.

setup: Spirit appears beside a target; caster modifier +4 and spell-attack hit. Three d12s roll 4.
act: Choose its supported attack and resolve the hit.
expect: Deal 16 Psychic before defenses and apply Frightened until start of caster's next turn, with caster and spirit as fear sources. Later Bonus Actions use the printed teleport-and-attack behavior without a new slot.

setup: Choose a legal self-targeting action spell of level 5 or lower and a perceptible trigger. Both slots and required components are available.
act: Cast Contingency and cause the stated trigger twice.
expect: Spend both slots at preparation. The contingent spell takes effect on the caster at the first trigger and Contingency ends. The second trigger spends nothing and creates no duplicate effect.

setup: Nighttime and three eligible Small or Medium Humanoid corpses.
act: Cast at level 6 and give a command as a Bonus Action.
expect: Create three Ghouls and record the control expiry. Daytime casting is ineligible. A later extension controls only the printed count and charges its own slot.

setup: One creature fails Dexterity, another succeeds. All d6s roll 4.
act: Resolve separately with a level-6 slot.
expect: Failure takes 100 Force before defenses. Success takes no damage. A target reduced to 0 HP by this damage is disintegrated under the spell's remains rule.

setup: A visible creature fails Wisdom. Choose Asleep, then deal damage to it.
act: Apply the chosen effect and damage.
expect: It becomes Unconscious and wakes on damage. The casting remains available for a different eligible target on a later Magic action.

setup: Familiar fixed destination is on this plane, with a known physical route. A second requested destination is a moving ship.
act: Cast separately.
expect: First returns the most direct physical route using supplied route facts. Moving destination fails.

setup: Target fails initial Constitution, then rolls three successful subsequent Constitution saves before three failures.
act: Resolve saves at turn ends.
expect: Initial failure restrains. The third success ends the spell without Petrified. Track successes and failures separately without rerolling prior results.

setup: A legal warded area excludes teleport entry and chooses Fiends for damage. All d10s roll 4.
act: Fiend enters on foot and an ordinary creature attempts teleport entry.
expect: Fiend receives 20 Radiant or Necrotic according to the chosen type before defenses. Teleport entry is blocked independently of creature type.

setup: Two targets in the 60-ft sphere fail and succeed Constitution. All d6s roll 4.
act: Use immediate detonation.
expect: Apply 40 and 20 Cold before defenses. Freeze qualifying exposed water according to the spell's area and depth.

setup: An ally is inside the globe and enemy is outside.
act: Cast a level-5 spell from outside affecting ally, then a level-6 spell.
expect: Level-5 effect cannot affect the ally, even if upcast. Level-6 spell is not excluded by this level-6 globe.

setup: Ward a legal floor area and identify exempt allies. Choose a supported additional effect.
act: Have an ally and an intruder cross a fogged corridor and warded stairs.
expect: Exempt ally uses the stated exemption. Intruder faces heavy obscurement and the stair Web under the ward. Each component has independent dispel handling.

setup: Target has 120 maximum and current HP. Fourteen d6s roll 4. It fails Constitution and lacks defenses.
act: Apply, then use Greater Restoration to end the maximum-HP reduction.
expect: Lose 56 HP and reduce maximum by 56. A successful-save replay takes 28 damage with no maximum reduction. Greater Restoration removes the maximum reduction, leaving current HP unchanged.

setup: Target has 100 missing HP plus Blinded, Deafened and Poisoned.
act: Cast at level 6.
expect: Restore 70 HP up to maximum and end all three listed conditions.

setup: Twelve creatures partake for the full hour; a thirteenth does not. Both d10s roll 6.
act: Finish consuming the feast and inspect effects for the next 24 hours.
expect: Eligible participants gain Resistance to Poison plus immunity to Frightened and Poisoned and +12 maximum/current HP. Effects start after the hour and expire after 24 hours. Nonparticipant gains nothing.

setup: A marked eligible object is on a table with no bearer. Its sapphire is in the caster's hand.
act: Crush sapphire and speak object's name.
expect: Object appears in caster's hand and sapphire is consumed. A separate held-object run reports its bearer/location as prescribed rather than teleporting it away.

setup: One target passes Wisdom and another fails, in independent runs.
act: Advance each affected turn.
expect: Success spends its movement dancing only through end of next turn. Failure also applies the spell's Charmed/dance restrictions until a successful repeat save or expiry.

setup: Caster has a valid container and body within range. A visible Humanoid fails the possession save.
act: Attempt possession and later return to the container while still in legal range.
expect: Track caster soul, original body and host as linked distinct states. Possession replaces control according to the spell and return restores the host without duplicating the caster.

setup: Twelve targets hear and understand an achievable safe instruction. One fails Wisdom and one succeeds.
act: Complete casting and damage the failed target with an ally.
expect: Only failures adopt the supplied activity and its Charmed effect. Allied damage ends the effect on that target.

setup: A 40-ft square of dirt contains a stone outcrop and plants.
act: Reshape dirt within the printed time and size limits.
expect: Change selected dirt elevation/shape without moving the stone outcrop directly or harming plants merely by this spell. Update mechanical terrain only when reshaping completes.

setup: Storyteller supplies a willing Fiend representative, a proposed payment and task.
act: Accept its negotiated terms.
expect: Create the supplied ally with its agreed obligations and payment. Do not impose automatic domination or invent a mandatory price.

setup: Set a valid trigger and a four-minute performance sequence.
act: Trigger once, wait for the performance to finish, then retrigger during the ten-minute cooldown.
expect: First performance plays once. Cooldown retrigger has no effect. It becomes eligible again after cooldown.

setup: A Large source plant and previously seen destination plant share a plane.
act: Cast and let two creatures enter during the duration.
expect: Each spends its required 5 ft to enter and exits the destination. At expiry the link closes and permits no further transit.

setup: Create legal panels with one creature in the wall's appearing space. Ten d6s roll 4.
act: Creature fails Dexterity and is pushed to caster-chosen side; destroy a separate 10-ft section.
expect: Initial failure takes 40 Cold before defenses. Destroying section leaves its printed frigid-air hazard, with its own movement-trigger save.

setup: A creature is in the wall when it appears. Seven d8s roll 4 and Dexterity fails.
act: Cast then try moving 5 ft through the wall.
expect: Initial damage is 28 Piercing before defenses. Moving 5 ft costs 20 ft of movement and triggers its separately timed Slashing damage.

setup: Willing creatures assume cloud form, then one elects to revert.
act: Travel and spend the full one-minute reversion time.
expect: Cloud has 300-ft hovering Fly Speed and the printed action limits. Reverting takes one minute with its prescribed incapacitation and movement restrictions.

setup: Caster designated a valid sanctuary previously. Five willing creatures stand within 5 ft, plus one farther away.
act: Cast.
expect: Caster and the five eligible companions arrive in nearest unoccupied spaces at the sanctuary. Farther creature remains.

setup: Caster modifier +4, target within 5 ft of sword, four d12s roll 4.
act: Resolve initial hit and later eligible Bonus Action attack.
expect: Each qualifying hit deals 20 Force before defenses. Each later move is at most 30 ft to a spot the caster can see.

setup: Bead persists through two caster turn ends after casting. All d6s roll 4.
act: End concentration and fail a target's Dexterity save.
expect: Base damage grows from 12d6 to 14d6, for 56 Fire before defenses. Successful-save replay takes 28.

setup: Three creatures with current HP 20, 30 and 51 fail Charisma.
act: Cast and inspect the hit-point thresholds.
expect: 20-HP target dies. 30-HP target receives its table's combined conditions. 51-HP target gains no HP-threshold effect. Special planar-type banishment is resolved separately.

setup: Caster is on the Material Plane with Speed 30 ft.
act: Enter Border Ethereal and move 10 ft upward, then end the spell in a legal empty space.
expect: Upward travel costs 20 ft. The caster returns to the original plane on expiry, with any obstructed return resolved by the printed displacement/damage rule.

setup: An eligible Humanoid fails Constitution and is killed. All d8s roll 4.
act: Resolve the spell and start the caster's next turn.
expect: Apply 58 Necrotic before defenses. The killed Humanoid rises as a Zombie under caster control at that turn start.

setup: Two contiguous chosen cubes include one creature in their overlap. Seven d10s roll 4.
act: Fail its Dexterity save.
expect: Creature takes 28 Fire before defenses once, not once per selected cube. Preserve the spell's chosen plant-fire behavior.

setup: Choose the solid-box form around a creature entirely inside its dimensions.
act: Creature attempts physical escape and later teleports with a successful Charisma save.
expect: Physical escape is blocked. Successful required teleport save permits that magical escape, charging its normal resources.

setup: Designate two guests and create the door in a legal location.
act: Try entry by a designated guest and an uninvited creature, then expire the dwelling.
expect: Guest can enter and uninvited creature cannot. On expiry occupants are expelled to the nearest open spaces under the spell.

setup: Caster and eight willing creatures form the required hand-linked circle, with correct tuning fork.
act: Choose a valid different-plane destination and cast.
expect: Transport all nine to the destination region as adjudicated. No attack roll or unwilling-target mechanic is introduced.

setup: One target in cone fails Dexterity. Fix ray d8 to 1 and all twelve damage d6s to 4.
act: Resolve the Red ray.
expect: Apply 48 Fire before defenses. Resolve only the selected ray unless the d8 selected the special two-ray result.

setup: Create the copy at a previously seen legal location; caster uses its remote senses.
act: Move and observe with the image, then let it take any damage.
expect: Only caster receives that view. Image is destroyed by damage and ends the spell. Caster's body does not teleport to the image.

setup: Wounded target missing a body part. All d8s roll 4.
act: Cast, advance two minutes and target turn starts.
expect: Initial heal is 31 HP up to maximum. Regain 1 HP at each target turn start and restore the severed part after two minutes.

setup: Creature died from injury 50 years ago and has a missing limb.
act: Complete casting with required component.
expect: Revive with full HP and restore missing body parts. Apply its printed return penalties and caster strain, including the extra strain for death at least a year ago.

setup: Unanchored target has no object to grab and no flight; an anchored object is in the cylinder.
act: Cast then end concentration after target reaches the top.
expect: Target falls upward to the top and falls back when the spell ends. Anchored object stays fixed.

setup: Willing touched creature and an explicit legal release condition.
act: Cast, advance outside time and then fulfill that condition.
