expect: Target is Invisible, protected from the specified detection and in suspended animation with time not passing for it. The release condition ends the sequestering.

setup: Eligible Humanoid stays within 10 ft throughout casting. Provide ice and consumed components.
act: Create duplicate and inspect HP and equipment.
expect: Create one duplicate with half the target's HP maximum and no copied equipment. Apply all printed limits on learning, healing, slots and recasting.

setup: Caster chooses a known permanent teleportation circle and eight willing visible creatures in range.
act: Cast using the permanent-circle familiarity row.
expect: Arrive on target with all eligible travelers. Preserve identities and records without duplicating inventory.

setup: Two willing creatures have different current forms and retained HP. Choose legal Large-or-smaller CR 4-or-lower Beasts.
act: Transform and use a later Magic action to choose new eligible forms.
expect: Each receives the selected stat block and printed temporary HP while retaining the listed original traits. Choices apply independently, and form changes follow the spell's temporary-HP replacement rule.

setup: A creature with an active magical modifier enters the aura while carrying a magic weapon.
act: Attempt a spell inside, attack with the weapon and then exit.
expect: Spell creation is blocked. Modifier and weapon magical properties are suppressed inside and resume outside if their durations remain. Suppression does not restart a duration.

setup: Choose Antipathy on an eligible object for a specified creature kind. A matching creature fails Wisdom and a different kind approaches.
act: Resolve both approaches.
expect: Only matching failure suffers the specified repulsion and movement obligation. Nonmatching creature is unaffected.

setup: Target fails Intelligence, all d12s roll 4, then fails the 30-day repeat save.
act: Apply then advance 30 days.
expect: Deal 40 Psychic before defenses and prevent spells and Magic actions. A failed repeat retains that restriction without a new damage application.

setup: Eligible target provides required flesh and legal vessel.
act: Complete casting, mature it 120 days, then let the original die with willing free soul.
expect: Only the matured clone accepts the soul. Preserve identity and personality while original possessions remain with the original body.

setup: Caster is outdoors with current weather supplied.
act: Change an eligible stage, wait the prescribed transition time, then go indoors.
expect: Weather changes within the allowed stage steps and five-mile area. Going indoors ends control and invokes the printed return behavior.

setup: A flat solid surface supports a legal Medium door.
act: Enter the newly created 30-ft room, leave an object there and allow door to expire.
expect: Door vanishes and object remains in that demiplane. A later valid casting can reopen the same known room.

setup: Visible non-Humanoid target fails Wisdom then succeeds after damage.
act: Give a command and resolve the damage save.
expect: The spell's Charmed control applies without a Humanoid/Beast type restriction. Successful repeat ends control and link.

setup: Place a legal tremor circle with one concentrating creature on the ground. Script the printed concentration/end-of-turn saves to fail.
act: Cast and end a caster turn.
expect: Apply the specific tremor saves and Prone/concentration results. Terrain is difficult. Storyteller supplies fissure and structure facts before their mechanical consequences resolve.

setup: Caster rolls 3 on a Charisma check, modifier +5.
act: Choose the replacement and let a magical truth detector examine speech.
expect: Check uses 15 plus 5 for total 20. Truth detector reports truthful under the spell.

setup: Select allies in the emanation. A Fiend hits one in melee and fails its required Constitution save.
act: Resolve hit and rider.
expect: Selected allies have Advantage on saves and enemies have Disadvantage on attacks against them. Fiend's failed rider save applies Blinded for the printed duration.

setup: One creature fails initial Dexterity and another succeeds. All d8s roll 4.
act: Resolve cloud and move it on later caster turn per spell.
expect: Damage is 40 and 20 Fire before defenses. Area is Heavily Obscured; later movement and triggers follow the spell's per-turn limit.

setup: Visible creature is banished. Its first Investigation total is 19 and second is 20.
act: Take Study actions on successive turns.
expect: First fails escape and second succeeds against DC 20, returning it to former space or nearest legal unoccupied space.

setup: Willing touched creature is targeted by Psychic damage, Charm and a magical location query.
act: Resolve during duration.
expect: Prevent Psychic damage and Charmed, and reveal no protected mental/location information through the forbidden methods.

setup: Targets have 150 and 151 HP, in separate runs.
act: Cast then let the 150-HP target succeed on a turn-end Constitution save.
expect: 150 receives Stunned until successful repeat. 151 instead has Speed 0 until start of caster's next turn.

setup: A creature fails initial Strength; all d10s roll 4.
act: Cast wall, then advance its first move/height reduction.
expect: Initial damage is 24 Bludgeoning before defenses. Wall moves and shrinks as printed, with later damage based on its current height.

setup: Caster and eight willing companions are on a non-Astral plane with required components.
act: Project then end the spell for one traveler in a permitted way.
expect: Each original body remains Unconscious in suspended animation. Projection and original retain one identity with silver-cord linkage. Returning ends only that traveler's projection unless the spell states a group consequence.

setup: Willing touched creature has no other modifiers.
act: Roll a check, attack and save, and an enemy attack against it.
expect: Target has Advantage on all three D20 Tests. Enemy attack has Disadvantage. A recast ends the prior instance.

setup: Portal connects legal empty origin and an exact known different-plane destination.
act: Move through from both sides then end concentration.
expect: Travel works in both directions while open. Portal closes with concentration and no further transit occurs.

setup: Target passes Wisdom, and caster tries again during the next 24 hours.
act: Resolve both attempts.
expect: First has no effect and grants immunity to this spell for 24 hours. Second cannot impose imprisonment during that immunity.

setup: Three eligible visible targets are missing 400, 250 and 100 HP, with listed removable conditions.
act: Allocate 400/200/100 healing.
expect: Total allocation 700. Each heals up to its allocation and maximum, and each healed target loses Blinded, Deafened and Poisoned.

setup: One creature is in overlapping spheres and fails Dexterity. It has Fire Resistance only; all d6s roll 4.
act: Resolve all four impacts simultaneously.
expect: Apply 40 Fire after Resistance and 80 Bludgeoning, total 120. Overlapping spheres do not apply a second full damage instance to it.

setup: Target has 1 of 100 HP plus Charmed, Frightened, Paralyzed, Poisoned, Stunned and Prone.
act: Cast and let target accept the offered stand-up reaction.
expect: Restore to 100 HP, end the five listed conditions and allow standing via the reaction without movement expenditure.

setup: Two independent targets have 100 and 101 HP. All d12s roll 4.
act: Cast separately.
expect: 100-HP target dies. 101-HP target instead takes 48 Psychic before defenses.

setup: Caster level 17 has seen an eligible CR 10 creature. Current HP and hit dice are recorded.
act: Select the form, then later change to another eligible form.
expect: Apply form's allowed stat block and temporary HP while preserving the spell's listed original attributes. Enforce restrictions on legendary/lair actions and equipment.

setup: One creature under the storm fails initial Constitution and all d6s roll 4.
act: Cast and advance to round two.
expect: Initial damage is 8 Thunder and Deafened for the spell's stated duration. Round two applies its Acid precipitation with correct area and separate timing.

setup: Fix d4 to 3. Caster can move and has harmless self-targeted actions.
act: Take turns, then use an action affecting another creature before all four are used.
expect: Grant four caster turns with no elapsed time for others. Affecting the other creature ends Time Stop immediately after that action.

setup: Choose an eligible creature-to-object form and maintain concentration for a full hour.
act: Finish duration, then apply a permitted end condition separately.
expect: Full-hour transformation lasts until dispelled as stated. Track original identity and printed reversion conditions, preserving original records for correction.

setup: Eligible creature died 150 years ago from injury and has no remaining body.
act: Speak its name and complete casting with required components.
expect: Create a new body and restore full HP. End listed poisons, contagions, curses and conditions. Old-age death remains ineligible.

setup: Two creatures in sphere fail and succeed Wisdom. All d10s roll 4.
act: Resolve and advance the failed target to its repeat save.
expect: Failure takes 40 Psychic before defenses and Frightened. Success takes half damage only under the spell; follow its repeat-save/tick sequence for the failed target.

setup: Choose to duplicate an enabled spell of level 8 or below whose normal components are absent.
act: Cast Wish with an eligible duplicate option and resolve its selected effect.
expect: Spend the level-9 slot and duplicate the effect without requiring the duplicated spell's components or other cast requirements. Duplication does not incur the stress reserved for other uses of Wish.

setup: New Dragonborn has no explicit size override.
act: Apply species.
expect: Size is Medium and its collision footprint uses the approved Medium footprint.

setup: New Dragonborn has no speed overrides.
act: Apply species.
expect: Walking Speed is 30 ft.

setup: New Dragonborn chooses Silver.
act: Apply ancestry and inspect linked breath/resistance.
expect: Cold is recorded for both breath damage and Resistance. Selecting Copper instead yields Acid for both.

setup: Level 5, Constitution +3 and proficiency +3; choose Silver ancestry and all d10s roll 4.
act: Replace one Attack-action attack with a chosen cone and fail one target's Dexterity save.
expect: Save DC 14 and damage 8 Cold before defenses. Consume one of three uses and one attack, with no extra action. Long Rest restores uses.

setup: Silver Dragonborn faces 12 Cold and 12 Fire.
act: Apply both.
expect: Cold becomes 6 through Resistance and Fire stays 12.

setup: Level-5 Dragonborn has Speed 30 and unused trait.
act: Activate Bonus Action then become Incapacitated.
expect: Gain Fly Speed 30 for up to ten minutes. Incapacitated ends wings early. Use returns after Long Rest.

setup: New Dwarf has no size override.
act: Apply species.
expect: Size is Medium.

setup: New Dwarf has no speed override.
act: Apply species.
expect: Walking Speed is 30 ft.

setup: Dwarf faces a Poisoned save and 12 Poison damage.
act: Resolve both.
expect: Save has Advantage and damage is 6 after Resistance.

setup: Dwarf advances from level 1 through 3 with HP ledger already calculated without species.
act: Apply grants incrementally and compare direct creation at level 3.
expect: Maximum HP increases by 1 at level 1 and by 3 total at level 3, with identical direct and incremental totals.

setup: New Elf has no size override.
act: Apply species.
expect: Size is Medium.

setup: New Elf has not selected a Wood Elf speed grant.
act: Apply species.
expect: Base walking Speed is 30 ft.

setup: Choose Wood Elf and Wisdom as trait spell ability.
act: Create at level 1, advance to 3 then 5, and use a free Longstrider cast.
expect: Speed 35 and Druidcraft at 1; Longstrider at 3 and Pass without Trace at 5, always prepared. Their free casts have separate once-per-Long-Rest uses and use Wisdom. Drow's unavailable grants remain recorded and acknowledged.

setup: Elf attempts a save to end Charmed and an unrelated Wisdom save.
act: Roll both.
expect: Only the save to avoid or end Charmed receives this trait's Advantage.

setup: Choose Survival, then independently try a nonlisted skill.
act: Apply the trait.
expect: Grant Survival proficiency once. Nonlisted choice is invalid for this trait.

setup: Elf has no other rest blockers and is targeted by magical Sleep.
act: Resolve sleep attempt, then complete four conscious hours in Trance.
expect: Magic cannot put the Elf to sleep. Four hours of Trance satisfies its Long Rest timing without Unconscious.

setup: New Gnome has no size override.
act: Apply species.
expect: Size is Small.

setup: New Gnome has no speed override.
act: Apply species.
expect: Walking Speed is 30 ft.

setup: Gnome makes Intelligence, Wisdom, Charisma and Dexterity saves.
act: Resolve all.
expect: First three have Advantage; Dexterity gains none from this trait.

setup: Forest Gnome, Intelligence chosen and proficiency +2.
act: Use Speak with Animals without a slot twice, then attempt a third free cast and finish Long Rest.
expect: Grant Minor Illusion and always-prepared Speak with Animals. Two free uses exhaust, a third needs a slot/recorded override, and Long Rest restores two. Rock Gnome grants its alternative cantrips and independently tracks three devices with eight-hour expiry.

setup: New Goliath has no size override.
act: Apply species.
expect: Size is Medium.

setup: New Goliath has no speed override.
act: Apply species.
expect: Walking Speed is 35 ft.

setup: Choose Stone's Endurance, Constitution +3, proficiency +2, incoming damage 12 and d12 result 5.
act: Use Reaction on the damage.
expect: Reduce damage by 8 to 4 and spend one of two trait uses plus Reaction. Short Rest does not recharge; Long Rest does. Other ancestry choices are mutually exclusive.

setup: Level-5 Goliath stands in enough space and has Speed 35.
act: Activate and let ten minutes expire.
expect: Become Large, gain Advantage on Strength checks and Speed 45. Expiry restores prior size and Speed. A second explicit use before Long Rest warns and records excess use under A01 instead of creating a recharge.

setup: Medium Goliath has Strength 16 and attempts an ability check to end Grappled.
act: Resolve check and carrying-capacity derivation.
expect: Escape check has Advantage. Capacity is calculated as one size larger, without changing actual size or attack reach.

setup: New Halfling has no size override.
act: Apply species.
expect: Size is Small.

setup: New Halfling has no speed override.
act: Apply species.
expect: Walking Speed is 30 ft.

setup: Halfling makes a save to avoid Frightened and an unrelated Constitution save.
act: Resolve both.
expect: Only Frightened save gains this trait's Advantage.

setup: Small Halfling's path crosses a Medium creature's space.
act: Move through and attempt to stop in the occupied space.
expect: Transit is allowed, while stopping there remains ineligible.

setup: Halfling rolls natural 1 on a D20 Test then reroll result 4.
act: Accept Lucky reroll.
expect: Use 4 as the die result even if it fails. A damage die of 1 does not qualify.

setup: Small Halfling is obscured only by a Medium creature.
act: Attempt Hide.
expect: That cover meets this trait's special Hide eligibility. Resolve the normal Hide test rather than granting automatic success.

setup: New Human chooses Small, then rebuilds with Medium.
act: Commit each draft independently.
expect: Persist the selected legal size. No random or height-derived size replaces the explicit choice.

setup: New Human has no speed override.
act: Apply species.
expect: Walking Speed is 30 ft.

setup: Human has spent Heroic Inspiration.
act: Complete Long Rest.
expect: Grant Heroic Inspiration once, without stacking duplicate inspiration charges.

setup: Human chooses Arcana not already proficient.
act: Apply species.
expect: Grant one Arcana proficiency and record Human as source.

setup: Human chooses Alert as Origin feat.
act: Apply and separately try a General feat.
expect: Grant Alert and its benefits. General feat is ineligible for this choice; Skilled is a recommendation rather than a forced selection.

setup: New Orc has no size override.
act: Apply species.
expect: Size is Medium.

setup: New Orc has no speed override.
act: Apply species.
expect: Walking Speed is 30 ft.

setup: Orc has proficiency +3, Speed 30 and no temporary HP.
act: Use the Bonus Action then finish Short Rest after spending all uses.
expect: Gain Dash's +30 movement budget and 3 temporary HP without stacking. Three uses exist, and Short Rest restores them.

setup: Orc drops to 0 HP from damage without outright death and has unused trait.
act: Accept the trait, then repeat before Long Rest.
expect: First drops to 1 instead. A second explicit use warns about spent allowance and records the excess under A01. Outright death does not trigger survival.

setup: New Tiefling chooses Small.
act: Apply species and reload the draft.
expect: Retain Small, with Medium also available as a separate legal choice.

setup: New Tiefling has no speed override.
act: Apply species.
expect: Walking Speed is 30 ft.

setup: Choose Chthonic and Charisma.
act: Create at level 1 and advance to 3 and 5.
expect: Grant Necrotic Resistance and Chill Touch, then False Life and Ray of Enfeeblement always prepared at the listed levels, with their independent free Long-Rest uses. Infernal Darkness is recorded unavailable.

setup: Tiefling selected Wisdom for Fiendish Legacy.
act: Cast Thaumaturgy through the species trait.
expect: Grant the cantrip and use Wisdom for trait-derived spellcasting. Its unavailable lighting branch remains disabled.

setup: Dexterity +2, proficiency +3, fixed initiative d20 10.
act: Roll initiative.
expect: Total 15, with proficiency added once.

setup: Alert user initiative 8 and willing ally 17, neither Incapacitated.
act: Swap immediately after roll and repeat with an Incapacitated participant.
expect: First swap gives 17 and 8. Incapacitated replay disallows the swap.

setup: Choose Cleric list and Charisma.
act: Select Guidance and Sacred Flame.
expect: Learn both with Charisma as this feat's casting ability. A Wizard-only cantrip is not a valid replacement in this selection.

setup: Same Cleric list, choose Cure Wounds.
act: Cast once free, then again using a level-1 slot, and finish Long Rest.
expect: Spell is always prepared. First spends its free use, second spends slot without a second free use. Rest restores the free use.

setup: Character gains a new level after choosing two cantrips and one level-1 spell.
act: Replace Cure Wounds with Bless and try replacing it with a level-2 spell.
expect: Bless is a legal same-level same-list replacement. Level-2 selection is rejected.

setup: Character already has Magic Initiate Cleric.
act: Take Magic Initiate Wizard and try another Cleric instance.
expect: Wizard instance is legal and tracked separately. Duplicate Cleric list is ineligible.

setup: Weapon hit, damage-die set A totals 4 and set B totals 9.
act: Choose B then try to use again on a second hit that turn.
expect: Use 9 for the first weapon dice and consume the once-per-turn use. No second benefit that turn.

setup: Character chooses Arcana, Stealth and Thieves' Tools without duplicates.
act: Apply feat.
expect: Grant exactly those three proficiencies with feat provenance.

setup: Character already has Skilled and chooses three additional distinct proficiencies.
act: Take again.
expect: Both grants persist and the repeat is permitted.

setup: Strength 19 and Dexterity 18.
act: Choose +1 to each and separately try +2 Strength.
expect: First gives 20/19. Second cannot raise Strength to 21 under this feat.

setup: Character already has one ASI and reaches another eligible feat choice.
act: Take ASI again within its score cap.
expect: Record another grant and apply its distinct legal increases once.

setup: Strength 19 and Dexterity 20.
act: Choose Strength increase.
expect: Strength becomes 20, Dexterity stays 20 and the feat cannot increase either above 20.

setup: Eligible Attack-action Unarmed Strike hits and target fails its required Grapple save.
act: Choose Damage plus Grapple then try again on a second hit in the same turn.
expect: Apply both effects on first, once per turn. A second hit cannot combine both via this benefit.

setup: One creature is Grappled by this character, another by an ally.
act: Attack each.
expect: Only attack against own Grappled target gains this feat's Advantage.

setup: Medium grappler moves with a Medium Grappled creature, then a Large one.
act: Move 10 ft in independent runs.
expect: Same-size target adds no carrying movement cost. Larger target retains normal extra movement.

setup: Ranged weapon attack baseline +5 and melee weapon attack baseline +5.
act: Apply fighting style.
expect: Ranged weapon attack is +7, melee remains +5. Ranged spell attacks gain no bonus.

setup: Base AC 14 while wearing Light armor, then remove armor.
act: Apply style and inspect both.
expect: Armored AC is 15; unarmored gains no style bonus.

setup: Eligible two-handed melee damage dice roll 1 and 2 with ability +4.
act: Apply style then compare an ineligible one-handed strike.
expect: Eligible dice become 3 and 3 for total 10. One-handed strike uses its actual dice.

setup: Legal Light extra attack deals die 4 and ability +3.

setup: Level 17 and qualifying Brutal Strike hit; both d10s roll 4.
act: Choose Forceful and Hamstring.
expect: Add 8 attack-type damage and apply both distinct riders. Do not allow the same rider twice.

setup: Strength score 22, Strength check total 15 and save total 25.
act: Choose replacement where useful.
expect: Check can become 22; save stays 25. Dexterity check gets no minimum.

setup: Speed 40 and Rage Bonus Action available.
act: Enter Rage and accept movement.
expect: Move up to 20 ft as part of that Bonus Action without a second action charge.

setup: Level 15, no Rage uses left and initiative rolled.
act: Regain uses then enter Rage, become Incapacitated and later Unconscious.
expect: Recharge all once per Long Rest. Rage can persist ten minutes without extensions and survives mere Incapacitated, but ends on Unconscious or Heavy armor.

setup: Strength 22 and Constitution 20 before feature.
act: Apply once and rebuild.
expect: Scores become 25 and 24, capped at 25, without stacking another +4 on rebuild.

setup: Choose eligible new skill, Strength +4 and Wisdom +1 while Raging.
act: Make Perception with Strength and compare an unlisted skill.
expect: Perception can use +4 ability plus its applicable proficiency. Grant chosen skill once. Unlisted skill receives no alternate-ability permission.

setup: First attack of turn uses Strength.
act: Choose Reckless and make more Strength attacks plus a Dexterity attack.
expect: Strength attacks have Advantage until next turn starts, attacks against Barbarian also have Advantage, and Dexterity attack gains none from this feature.

setup: Level 11, Raging, dropping to 0 without outright death and Constitution total 12.
act: Accept save then repeat another drop before a rest.
expect: First DC 10 succeeds and HP becomes 22. Next DC is 15. Short Rest resets DC to 10.

setup: No armor, Dexterity +2, Constitution +3 and a Shield.
act: Derive AC then equip armor.
expect: Unarmored base 15 plus Shield gives 17. Armor invokes normal AC derivation rather than adding both base formulas.

setup: Level-1 Barbarian chooses Greataxe and Handaxe.
act: Apply choices then exchange one on Long Rest.
expect: Enable those two masteries. Rest replaces one choice, preserving count. A ranged-only weapon cannot fill this melee-only choice.

setup: Level-1 Bard Charisma +3, ally within 60 ft sees/hears, die d6 result 4.
act: Grant die and let ally fail DC 15 with total 12, then spend die.
expect: Bonus Action and one use grant one die. Test becomes 16 and die is consumed. Unused die expires after one hour.

setup: Ally 20 ft away fails a save causing Frightened. Bard has Reaction.
act: Accept Countercharm and roll replacement pair.
expect: Spend Reaction and reroll that save with Advantage, using the new result without altering unrelated effects.

setup: Bard level 2 chooses proficient Performance and Persuasion, proficiency +2.
act: Check each with Expertise, then reach level 9.
expect: Double proficiency to +4 in both. At 9 choose two additional proficient skills, without applying a third multiplier.

setup: Level-5 Bard has no Inspiration uses and one level-1 slot.
act: Convert the slot, spend use and finish Short Rest.
expect: Slot becomes one Inspiration use with no action. Short Rest restores all uses.

setup: Proficiency +3, unproficient Athletics, proficient Stealth and initiative.
act: Roll all.
expect: Athletics gains +1. Stealth uses its existing proficiency only. Initiative is not a skill check and gains no Jack bonus.

setup: Bard level 10 prepared count increases. A Cleric spell is eligible for available class-level slots.
act: Choose it as a new preparation.
expect: It becomes a Bard spell using Charisma and counts toward Bard preparations. No Warlock-only choice is granted by this feature.

setup: Bard rolls initiative with 0, 1 and 3 uses in separate runs.
act: Apply feature.
expect: Uses become 2, 2 and 3 respectively.

setup: Bard casts Power Word Heal on a legal target; second legal target is 8 ft away.
act: Use the feature.
expect: Both receive spell effects, with only one spell cast/resource charge. Both Power Word spells remain always prepared.

setup: Choose Divine Strike. On-turn weapon hit and d8 result 5.
act: Use once then hit again same turn.
expect: First gains 5 chosen Radiant/Necrotic damage. Second gains none. Potent Spellcasting is an alternative choice, not an additional simultaneous grant.

setup: Cleric Wisdom +3 and proficiency +2; uses available.
act: Choose Divine Spark to heal a creature in range, then finish Short Rest.
expect: Use one Channel Divinity and the specified Magic action. Heal its rolled dice plus Wisdom under the printed scaling. Short Rest restores one use up to maximum. Turn Undead is a separate selectable route with DC 13.

setup: Eligible level-5-or-lower Cleric spell has costly components, and feature unused.
act: Select it as Magic action.
expect: Cast without slot or Material components, and spend the once-per-Long-Rest feature. Reaction-time spells are ineligible.

setup: Choose Thaumaturge with Wisdom +3.
act: Learn extra cantrip and roll Arcana and History.
expect: Gain one Cleric cantrip and +3 on Arcana/Religion checks. History receives no benefit. Protector instead grants Martial weapons and Heavy armor.

setup: Use Divine Intervention to choose Wish. Both d4s roll 3.
act: Cast then finish successive Long Rests.
expect: Feature remains unavailable until six Long Rests complete. Ordinary once-per-rest recharge does not override this cooldown.

setup: Choose Divine Strike and both d8s roll 4.
act: Apply to eligible hit.
expect: Extra damage is 8. In the alternative Potent route, a damaging Cleric cantrip can grant temporary HP equal to twice Wisdom to one eligible recipient.

setup: Wounded caster heals another via a level-3 slot.
act: Resolve heal then repeat with a free cast.
expect: Slotted cast heals caster by 5, once after casting. Free cast does not trigger Blessed Healer.

setup: Level-2 slotted healing spell has both immediate and later-turn healing.
act: Resolve each.
expect: Immediate healing on casting turn gains 4 HP. Later-turn healing gains no Disciple bonus from that cast.

setup: Life Cleric advances 3,5,7,9.
act: Inspect domain grants.
expect: At 3 always prepare Aid/Bless/Cure Wounds/Lesser Restoration; at 5 add Mass Healing Word/Revivify; 7 Aura of Life/Death Ward; 9 Greater Restoration/Mass Cure Wounds. They do not consume ordinary preparation choices.

setup: Level-6 Cleric, pool 30; two Bloodied allies within 30 ft have HP 4/20 and 7/30.
act: Allocate 6 and 8 to them.
expect: They reach 10/20 and 15/30. Further healing above half maximum is ineligible even if pool remains. Spend one Channel Divinity.

setup: A healing spell rolls 2d8 +3.
act: Apply Supreme Healing.
expect: Restore 19 before HP cap without rolling healing dice. Non-healing damage dice are unaffected.

setup: Wisdom +3, Turn Undead and three d8s roll 4. One Undead fails and one succeeds.
act: Resolve Turn Undead.
expect: Failure takes 12 Radiant and retains turn effect despite this damage. Success takes no Sear damage.

setup: Three new legal skills chosen.
act: Apply subclass.
expect: Grant exactly three skills with subclass provenance and no duplicate proficiency stacking.

setup: Visible enemy 40 ft away succeeds DC 15 check with total 17; Inspiration die is 4.
act: Spend Reaction and Inspiration.
expect: Reduce total to 13 and change result to failure. Resource and reaction are consumed once.

setup: Choose two eligible Wizard/Cleric/Druid spells within class-slot levels.
act: Apply and later replace one on a Bard level gain.
expect: Both are always prepared independently of ordinary choices. Replacement uses same eligibility and updates the ledger once.

setup: Failed attack total 10 vs AC 17; Inspiration die is 4.
act: Use Peerless Skill.
expect: Total 14 still fails, so Inspiration use is not expended. Successful replay would consume it.

setup: No Wild Shape uses on initiative. Later two uses available.
act: Roll initiative, then convert two uses to a slot.
expect: Regain one use on initiative when empty. Conversion gives one level-4 slot and spends two uses, once per Long Rest.

setup: Wild-Shaped Druid has an eligible spell without costly/consumed Material and another with a consumed component.
act: Attempt both.
expect: Allow the former in Beast form and disallow the latter through this feature.

setup: Choose Polar on Long Rest then later Temperate.
act: Inspect at Druid level 7.
expect: Polar grants Fog Cloud/Hold Person/Ray of Frost/Sleet Storm/Ice Storm. Switching replaces these with Temperate's level-eligible list. Deferred spells remain recorded unavailable.

setup: Level 10, point within 60 ft, two damaged enemies and one wounded ally in sphere. All d6s roll 4.
act: Use Magic action and one Wild Shape; enemies fail/succeed Constitution.
expect: Damage is 12/6 Necrotic before defenses and chosen ally heals 12 up to max.

setup: Level-6 Druid has spent slots and free Circle Spell use available.
act: Cast an eligible Circle Spell free, then recover on Short Rest.
expect: One free cast per Long Rest. Recover at most three combined slot levels, none level 6+, once per Long Rest.

setup: Nature's Ward has a chosen Resistance; legal point within 120 ft and Wild Shape use available.
act: Create cube, move it by Bonus Action, then become Incapacitated.
expect: 15-ft cube gives caster/allies Half Cover and allies the current Nature's Ward Resistance. Move up to 60 ft within range. Incapacitated ends it.

setup: Choose Polar land and face Cold damage and Poisoned.
act: Apply Ward, then choose another land after Long Rest.
expect: Gain Poisoned immunity and Cold Resistance for Polar. Land change updates that Resistance without adding another land's Resistance.

setup: Druidic hidden message, non-Druid observer Investigation 15.
act: Read as Druid then inspect as observer.
expect: Druid reads automatically. Observer detects presence but cannot decipher without magic. Speak with Animals stays always prepared.

setup: Choose Primal Strike; qualifying on-turn weapon hit and d8 result 4.
act: Select Thunder.
expect: Add 4 Thunder once on turn. Potent alternative adds Wisdom to Druid cantrip damage instead.

setup: Potent branch cantrip range 60 ft; separate Primal branch rolls 4 on both d8s.
act: Apply upgrade in independent runs.
expect: Potent eligible range becomes 360 ft. Primal extra damage becomes 8. Do not grant both branches simultaneously.

setup: Choose Magician and Wisdom +3.
act: Inspect cantrips and roll Nature/Arcana/Religion checks.
expect: One extra Druid cantrip and +3 Nature/Arcana checks. Religion gains no bonus. Warden alternatively grants Martial weapons and Medium armor.

setup: Wild Shape use and no Material components.
act: Use Magic action to cast Find Familiar with Wild Shape expenditure.
expect: Create a Fey familiar, spend one use rather than a slot, and remove it on Long Rest. Slot expenditure is an alternative path.

setup: No Wild Shape uses and a level-1 slot exists.
act: Spend slot to gain one use, then try another conversion same turn.
expect: One use gained without action, once per turn. Converting a Wild Shape use back to a level-1 slot is separately once per Long Rest.

setup: Level-2 Druid selects a learned legal no-fly CR 1/4 Beast and has two uses.
act: Bonus Action transform and later become Incapacitated.
expect: Spend one use, grant temporary HP equal Druid level and apply allowed form stats while retaining listed original traits. Incapacitated reverts. Short Rest restores one use.

setup: Rage damage +2, Rage and Reckless active, Strength hit and two d6s roll 4.
act: Resolve first and second hits on turn.
expect: First target takes 8 additional attack-type damage. Second hit gains no second Frenzy instance.

setup: Strength +4, proficiency +4, legal enemies in 30-ft emanation.
act: Use Bonus Action; one fails Wisdom and later succeeds repeat.
expect: DC 16; failed target is Frightened until successful turn-end repeat or one-minute expiry. Recharge once per Long Rest, or spend one Rage to restore use.

setup: Berserker currently Frightened and enters Rage.
act: Resolve Rage then try a new Charmed effect.
expect: Existing Frightened ends and Charmed is prevented while Rage remains.

setup: Creature 5 ft away damages Berserker; Reaction available.
act: Accept retaliation.
expect: Spend Reaction for one melee weapon/Unarmed Strike against that creature. A source outside 5 ft cannot trigger it.

setup: Level-17 Fighter has two uses and an available turn.
act: Use once, attempt twice same turn, then use on a later turn.
expect: Ordinary allowance is one additional non-Magic action per use and once per turn. Warn and permit an explicit repeated invocation under A01. Two uses per rest at 17, restored on Short or Long Rest.

setup: Champion already has Defense.
act: Choose Archery.
expect: Retain Defense and add Archery as distinct eligible Fighting Style grant.

setup: In combat without Heroic Inspiration.
act: Start turn twice, spending Inspiration between.
expect: Gain Inspiration each eligible turn start without stacking multiple charges.

setup: Weapon and spell attacks roll natural 19.
act: Resolve both.
expect: Weapon scores Critical Hit; spell attack does not gain this expanded range.

setup: Initiative and Athletics check with no other advantage.
act: Roll both.
expect: Both have Advantage, without adding proficiency if absent.

setup: Weapon attack natural 18 and Unarmed Strike natural 20.
act: Resolve both.
expect: Both are Critical Hits under expanded 18–20 range.

setup: Constitution +3, Bloodied at 10/40 HP and natural death-save roll 18 in separate runs.
act: Start turn and resolve death save.
expect: Turn-start heal is 8 up to cap while at least 1 HP. Death-save 18 gains natural-20 benefit and rolls have Advantage.

setup: Fighter chooses Archery then gains another Fighter level.
act: Replace with Defense.
expect: Archery benefit ends, Defense begins and one chosen style remains. Recommendation is optional.

setup: Level-9 Fighter fails a save; replacement die total without feature is 8.
act: Reroll using Indomitable.
expect: Add 9 for new total 17 and use it. Spend one use and restore on Long Rest.

setup: Wounded level-4 Fighter, d10 result 6 and uses available.
act: Use Bonus Action, then finish Short Rest.
expect: Heal 10 up to max and spend one use. Short Rest restores one, Long Rest all.

setup: Attack misses target A; target B nearby.
act: Attack B, then A before end of next turn.
expect: Only next attack against A gains Advantage from the original miss. Expire unused grant at printed boundary.

setup: Mastered weapon would use Vex.
act: Choose Push for one attack then attack again with native mastery.
expect: First attack uses Push instead of Vex, second can use native Vex. Do not apply both to the same attack via this feature.

setup: Failed check total 9 against DC 15; d10 result 4.
act: Try Tactical Mind then run successful replay with d10 7.
expect: First remains failure at 13 and spends no Second Wind use. Replay succeeds at 16 and spends one. Neither heals HP.

setup: Speed 30 and eligible Second Wind Bonus Action.
act: Heal and move 15 ft past an enemy.
expect: Allow up to 15 ft without Opportunity Attacks as part of that activation.

setup: Level-20 Fighter takes Attack action.
act: Resolve normal attacks.
expect: Four attacks from that action, replacing lower count rather than adding four to existing attacks.

setup: Level-11 Fighter takes Attack action.
act: Resolve normal attacks.
expect: Three attacks, replacing ordinary Extra Attack's two.

setup: Level-1 Fighter chooses three proficient weapon kinds.
act: Complete Long Rest and replace one.
expect: Exactly three active mastery choices and one replacement, with higher counts governed by progression table.

setup: Unarmored, no Shield, legal vertical path and liquid surface.
act: Move on own turn and then end movement without support.
expect: Allow movement across surfaces during turn. This feature does not grant hovering or immunity to falling afterward.

setup: Dexterity 22 and Wisdom 20.
act: Apply capstone once and rebuild.
expect: Dexterity 25 and Wisdom 24, each capped at 25 without repeat stacking.

setup: Level-5 Monk Dexterity +3 takes 12 qualifying physical attack damage; d10 is 4.
act: Use Reaction then redirect with one Focus, both Martial Arts d8s roll 4.
expect: Reduce damage by 12 to zero. Legal failed-Dexterity redirect target takes 11 of source attack type before defenses. Spend Reaction and one Focus only when redirect chosen.

setup: Level-13 Monk is hit by pure Fire attack, with sufficient reduction.
act: Use Deflect Attacks.
expect: Fire attack now qualifies. Retain normal reaction/reduction/redirect rules.

setup: Monk lacks Charisma save proficiency and has Focus available.
act: Apply feature and reroll failed save.
expect: Gain all saving-throw proficiencies once. Reroll spends one Focus and new result must be used.

setup: Eligible Unarmed Strike damage would be Bludgeoning.
act: Choose Force.
expect: Resolve same amount as Force, preserving attack modifiers and critical dice.

setup: Dexterity half-damage effect deals 20 before save.
act: Run success, failure and Incapacitated failure.
expect: Ordinary success takes 0, ordinary failure 10, Incapacitated failure normal 20 before defenses.

setup: Monk chooses each enhanced Focus route in separate runs.
act: Spend one Focus on Flurry, Patient Defense or Step.
expect: Flurry grants three strikes. Paid Patient Defense grants rolled temporary HP. Paid Step can move a willing Large-or-smaller adjacent ally without its movement provoking.

setup: Level-1 Monk unarmored, no Shield, Dexterity +3, Martial Arts die 4.
act: Use Unarmed Strike and its Bonus Action option.
expect: Damage 7 and Dexterity can set attack/Grapple DC. Bonus Action strike is available without requiring an Attack action first. Armor/Shield disables these benefits.

setup: Level-2 Monk Wisdom +3, proficiency +2 and two Focus.
act: Use paid Flurry and finish Short Rest.
expect: Bonus Action grants two Unarmed Strikes and spends one Focus. Save DC 13 for Focus features. Rest restores both points.

setup: Initiative rolled with two Focus and Uncanny Metabolism declined.
act: Apply feature.
expect: Regain to four, without adding four or exceeding current value if already above four.

setup: Monk is Charmed and Poisoned at own turn end.
act: Choose to remove Poisoned.
expect: Remove only chosen condition. No action cost. Forgoing food/drink adds no Exhaustion through those causes.

setup: Level-4 Monk falls for 28 damage, Reaction available.
act: Use Slow Fall.
expect: Reduce fall damage by 20 to 8 before other defenses.

setup: Qualifying hit, Focus available and target succeeds Constitution.
act: Spend one Focus.
expect: Target is not Stunned but Speed halves and next attack against it has Advantage until start of Monk's next turn. Failed-save replay instead Stuns to that boundary.

setup: Three Focus available at turn start; 12 Fire and 12 Force incoming.
act: Activate then apply damage.
expect: Spend 3 Focus, take 6 Fire and 12 Force. Incapacitated ends protection before one-minute expiry.

setup: Unarmored no Shield, Dexterity +3 and Wisdom +2.
act: Derive AC then equip Shield.
expect: Base AC 15 while eligible. Shield prevents using this formula.

setup: Base Speed 30, Monk level 2 then 6, unarmored no Shield.
act: Derive Speed and compare when armored.
expect: Speed 40 at 2 and 45 at 6. Armor or Shield removes this feature's bonus.

setup: Level-5 Monk has zero Focus and is wounded; d8 is 4.
act: Roll initiative and accept.
expect: Restore all Focus and heal 9 HP up to cap, once per Long Rest.

setup: Eligible Bonus Action is Wholeness of Body.
act: Use it then Step of the Wind.
expect: Permit the feature's immediate Step after that Bonus Action without a second Bonus Action. It cannot chain from Step itself.

setup: Flurry hit, eligible target and failed Dexterity.
act: Choose Topple.
expect: Apply Prone without an extra Focus beyond Flurry. An ordinary non-Flurry hit cannot invoke the technique.

setup: Unarmed hit with four Focus and same-plane target; all ten d12s roll 4.
act: Set vibrations and later forgo one Attack-action attack to end them; target fails Constitution.
expect: Spend four initially, deal 40 Force at ending and remove vibration record. Only one target can carry current vibrations.

setup: Wounded Monk Wisdom +3 and Martial Arts die 5.
act: Use Bonus Action.
expect: Heal 8 up to max, with three uses per Long Rest.

setup: Charisma +3, three visible enemies in range, Channel Divinity available.
act: Use Magic action; one fails Wisdom then takes damage.
expect: Failed target is Frightened with its one-of-movement/action/Bonus-Action restriction. Damage ends it. Spend one Channel Divinity.

setup: Aura radius formerly 10 ft and ally 25 ft away.
act: Apply feature.
expect: Aura becomes 30-ft emanation and ally now qualifies if other aura conditions hold.

setup: Frightened ally enters active Aura of Protection.
act: Enter and later leave before original fear expires.
expect: Suppress Frightened inside; original remaining effect resumes outside.

setup: Charisma +3 and ally in 10-ft aura. Another Paladin aura gives +2.
act: Make save, then Incapacitate first Paladin.
expect: Choose one aura, gaining +3 while first is active. Auras do not stack. Incapacitated removes first aura's bonus.

setup: Two uses and legal same-area Fiend within 60 ft.
act: Activate Divine Sense as Bonus Action and then become Incapacitated.
expect: Spend one use and report qualifying creature location/type for up to ten minutes. Incapacitated ends awareness. Short Rest restores one use.

setup: Find Steed free use available, spell always prepared.
act: Cast free then cast again using slot.
expect: Only first consumes the trait's free use. Second spends selected slot. Long Rest restores free cast.

setup: Choose Blessed Warrior with Guidance and Sacred Flame; Charisma +3.
act: Apply, then replace one cantrip on Paladin level gain.
expect: Both count as Paladin spells using Charisma. Replacement remains a Cleric cantrip. Fighting Style feat route is alternative.

setup: Level-4 pool 20; wounded Poisoned ally touched.
act: Spend 5 pool to remove Poisoned and 7 to heal.
expect: Pool becomes 8, Poisoned ends and HP rises by 7. The five spent for condition do not heal.

setup: Charmed ally enters active Aura of Protection.
act: Enter then exit while original charm remains.
expect: Charm has no effect inside. It resumes outside with remaining duration.

setup: Allies in Aura of Protection when Paladin casts Divine Smite.
act: Resolve and advance next turn start.
expect: Caster/allies gain Half Cover within aura until start of next Paladin turn.

setup: Advance Devotion Paladin 3,5,9,13,17.
act: Inspect oath preparations.
expect: Grant the printed two oath spells at each listed level, always prepared beyond ordinary count; at 3 Protection from Evil and Good/Shield of Faith, at 17 Commune/Flame Strike.

setup: Divine Smite always prepared, free use unused and triggering hit legal.
act: Cast free then try another free cast before rest.
expect: One free use per Long Rest; another cast requires slot. Trigger/action rules remain the spell's.

setup: Melee weapon or Unarmed hit, d8 result 5; ranged-only weapon hit separately.
act: Resolve.
expect: Eligible hit gains 5 Radiant before defenses. Ranged-only weapon does not qualify.

setup: Pool 20, ally Blinded and Stunned and missing HP.
act: Remove both using Lay On Hands.
expect: Spend ten pool for two conditions and heal no HP from those ten. Remaining pool stays ten.

setup: Choose two proficient weapon kinds.
act: Long Rest and change both choices.
expect: Exactly two active choices, with normal proficiency eligibility and no extra mastery count.

setup: Proficient Survival without Expertise, plus two legal languages chosen.
act: Apply feature.
expect: Grant Survival Expertise and both languages once. With proficiency +2, Survival's proficiency component becomes +4.

setup: Choose two proficient skills not already expert.
act: Apply and rebuild.
expect: Both gain doubled proficiency, without tripling an existing Expertise grant.

setup: Level-1 Ranger with two free uses.
act: Cast Hunter's Mark free twice then cast with slot.
expect: Spend two distinct free uses, then a selected slot; spell stays always prepared. Long Rest restores free uses.

setup: Choose Druidic Warrior with Guidance and Druidcraft.
act: Apply and replace one on Ranger level gain.
expect: Learn two Druid cantrips as Ranger spells using Wisdom. Replacement stays a Druid cantrip. Unavailable recommendations are not forced.

setup: Hunter's Mark hit and its die result 7.
act: Resolve at capstone.
expect: Mark uses d10 rather than d6. Preserve its Force type and per-hit conditions.

setup: Choose Multiattack Defense; enemy first hit succeeds.
act: Resolve subsequent attacks from same enemy this turn and one next turn.
expect: Remaining same-turn attacks have Disadvantage. Next turn has no inherited penalty. Rest can replace with Escape the Horde.

setup: Marked creature has Cold immunity, Fire resistance and Radiant vulnerability.
act: Apply Hunter's Mark.
expect: Reveal those exact defenses to Ranger while marked, without exposing unrelated private stats.

setup: Choose Colossus Slayer; target already wounded, d8 is 5.
act: Hit twice on same turn.
expect: First eligible weapon hit adds 5 weapon-type damage; second adds no second instance. Full-HP target does not qualify.

setup: Take 12 Fire and later 8 Fire plus 8 Cold on same turn.
act: Use Reaction on first Fire.
expect: Fire instances become 6 and 4. Cold stays 8. Resistance ends at current turn end.

setup: Mark hit adds 4 Force; other visible creature is 25 ft from target.
act: Apply feature then hit mark again that turn.
expect: Other creature takes the Mark's 4 Force once per turn. Second hit does not repeat this feature's splash.

setup: Wisdom +3 and feature unused.
act: Use Bonus Action and attack while Invisible, then end next turn.
expect: Invisible persists through attack because feature specifies duration, then ends at end of next turn. Three uses per Long Rest.

setup: Marked target A and unmarked B.
act: Attack both.
expect: Only A gains Advantage from this feature.

setup: Concentrating on Hunter's Mark and taking damage.
act: Resolve damage then become Incapacitated separately.
expect: Damage cannot break this concentration. Other valid ending conditions still end it.

setup: Speed 30, Medium armor.
act: Apply then equip Heavy armor.
expect: Walking 40 and Climb/Swim 40 while eligible. Heavy removes walking bonus, with Climb/Swim still equal current Speed under the feature.

setup: Wisdom +3, d8 is 5 and Exhaustion 2.
act: Use Magic action and finish Short Rest.
expect: Gain 8 temporary HP without stacking. Short Rest reduces Exhaustion to 1. Three temporary-HP uses restore on Long Rest.

setup: Choose Longbow and Shortsword, both proficient.
act: Change both after Long Rest.
expect: Two choices remain and each enables its own mastery only.

setup: Rogue has Bonus Action free.
act: Dash then compare attempting another Cunning Action on same turn.
expect: Dash uses Bonus Action and adds normal movement budget. No second Bonus Action is created.

setup: Sneak Attack 3d6, Dexterity +4/proficiency +3, eligible Large target.
act: Pay 1d6 for Trip and fail target Dexterity.
expect: Roll only 2d6 Sneak Attack plus ordinary damage, then apply Prone on failed DC 15 save.

setup: Sneak Attack 7d6 and eligible target.
act: Choose Knock Out for 6d6, fail Constitution, then deal damage later.
expect: Only 1d6 Sneak Attack remains. Target is Unconscious until damage, successful repeat or one minute.

setup: Not Incapacitated and an attacker otherwise has Advantage.
act: Resolve then repeat while Incapacitated.
expect: First attack cannot have Advantage. Incapacitated removes this protection.

setup: Dexterity half-damage effect deals 20.
act: Run successful and failed saves, plus Incapacitated failure.
expect: Take 0/10 normally and 20 on Incapacitated failure before defenses.

setup: Proficient Stealth and Sleight of Hand, proficiency +2.
act: Apply at 1 and gain 6.
expect: First two use +4 proficiency component. At 6 select two more proficient skills for Expertise.

setup: Sneak Attack 4d6 and legal Poison/Trip choices.
act: Pay 1d6 for each.
expect: Roll remaining 2d6 Sneak Attack and resolve both riders after damage. Do not regain dice if either save succeeds.

setup: Proficient tool check die 3 and unproficient skill check die 3.
act: Apply feature.
expect: Tool die becomes 10 before modifiers; unproficient die stays 3.

setup: Rogue lacks Wisdom/Charisma save proficiency.
act: Apply.
expect: Grant both proficiencies once, deriving proficiency from total character level.

setup: Level-5 Rogue hits with Finesse weapon; eligible ally adjacent to target and no Disadvantage. All three d6s roll 4.
act: Resolve then hit again same turn.
expect: First can add 12 attack-type damage. Second cannot repeat on that turn. A separate eligible reaction on another turn can qualify.

setup: Rogue has not moved this turn.
act: Use Bonus Action then attack and try to move.
expect: Next attack this turn has Advantage and Speed is 0 to turn end. Prior movement would make feature unavailable.

setup: Failed D20 Test, benefit available.
act: Use then finish Short Rest.
expect: Die becomes 20, with modifiers still applied. Use consumed and restored by the rest.

setup: A legal action-required magic item is in hand; Bonus Action free.
act: Activate through Fast Hands.
expect: Use item as Bonus Action while paying normal item charges and requirements. This does not universally turn ordinary spellcasting into a Bonus Action.

setup: Speed 30 and Dexterity score 18 versus Strength 10.
act: Apply and determine jumps.
expect: Climb Speed 30 and jump distance can use Dexterity instead of Strength under normal jump limits.

setup: Hide-granted Invisible and legal Sneak Attack; Three-Quarters Cover at end of turn.
act: Pay 1d6 for Stealth Attack.
expect: Reduce Sneak Attack dice by one and preserve Hide's Invisible if cover condition is met. Ending without required cover loses that preservation.

setup: Initiative 16 at combat start.
act: Schedule rounds 1 and 2.
expect: Two turns at 16 and 6 in round 1. Round 2 has only normal initiative turn.

setup: Three items attuned and a fourth eligible. Item charge d6 is 6; level-3 scroll Arcana total 12.
act: Attune fourth, activate item and use scroll.
expect: Fourth attunement allowed. Charge retained on 6. Scroll fails DC 13 and disintegrates. Scroll ability is Intelligence.

setup: Choose Elvish as extra language.
act: Apply.
expect: Know Thieves' Cant and Elvish with Rogue provenance, without spending another language choice.

setup: Visible attacker hits for 15 total damage, Reaction available.
act: Accept dodge.
expect: Damage becomes 7 before further applicable defenses and Reaction is spent. Non-attack damage cannot invoke this feature.

setup: Choose two proficient weapon kinds.
act: Replace choices after Long Rest.
expect: Exactly two masteries enabled, preserving proficiency restrictions.

setup: Innate Sorcery active, a known Metamagic option eligible.
act: Use free option on one spell then another spell on same turn.
expect: One option's cost waived on this turn. Additional uses pay normal costs unless another rule applies.

setup: Subclass level 3, Dexterity +2, Charisma +3 and unarmored.
act: Apply, then gain Sorcerer level 4.
expect: AC base 15. Maximum HP bonus is 3 at subclass grant and 4 after next Sorcerer level. Other-class levels do not add this bonus.

setup: Advance Sorcerer through 3,5,7,9.
act: Inspect automatic preparations.
expect: Grant listed Draconic spells beyond ordinary count, including Arcane Eye recorded unavailable at 7 and Summon Dragon at 9.

setup: Free Summon Dragon use available and no Material component.
act: Cast choosing nonconcentration variant.
expect: Spend free use, require no Material component and set one-minute duration without concentration. Other concentration can continue.

setup: Feature unused and no flying speed.
act: Activate Bonus Action then end after one hour; spend three Sorcery Points to restore.
expect: Gain Fly Speed 60 for duration, then remove it. Restoration spends three points and permits a later activation.

setup: Choose Fire, Charisma +4. A spell has two separate Fire damage rolls.
act: Apply Resistance and choose one roll for bonus.
expect: Incoming 12 Fire becomes 6. Add +4 to only one damage roll of that casting.

setup: Sorcerer level 5 with five points and one level-2 slot.
act: Convert slot to points near cap, then create a level-3 slot from five points as Bonus Action.
expect: Conversion grants two points up to maximum. Level-3 creation costs five points and Bonus Action. Created slot expires on Long Rest.

setup: Sorcerer DC 13 and two uses.
act: Activate Bonus Action and cast Sorcerer spells.
expect: For one minute DC 14 and Sorcerer attack rolls have Advantage. Other-class spells do not gain these benefits. Long Rest restores uses.

setup: Sorcerer level 2 selects two options.
act: Advance to 10 and 17 and replace one on level gain.
expect: Known options count 2/4/6 at those levels. Normally only one option per spell unless an option or feature permits more.

setup: Known Careful Spell, Charisma +3, Fireball catches three selected allies.
act: Spend one point for Careful.
expect: All three automatically pass and take no damage from the spell. Separate option-specific vectors cover every selectable Metamagic.

setup: Level 7 and six Sorcery Points spent.
act: Finish Short Rest twice without Long Rest.
expect: First can restore at most three points. Second cannot reuse this recovery before Long Rest.

setup: No Innate Sorcery uses and two points available.
act: Activate by spending points and apply two legal Metamagics to a spell.
expect: Spend two for activation and pay selected option costs. Up to two options may combine while Innate Sorcery is active.

setup: Warlock has feature unused and no available slot.
act: Contact own patron using the feature.
expect: Contact Other Plane is always prepared, cast without slot, and automatically passes its Intelligence save. Free use recharges on Long Rest.

setup: Two known invocations have a prerequisite relationship.
act: Try replacing the prerequisite and select an ineligible high-level option separately.
expect: Reject replacement that breaks a dependent invocation and reject unmet class-level prerequisites. One eligible replacement is allowed per Warlock level gain.

setup: All Pact slots spent and Magical Cunning available.
act: Complete the one-minute rite.
expect: Regain all Pact slots rather than the ordinary half, without restoring ordinary Spellcasting slots.

setup: Level 5, Charisma +3, enemy drops to 0 HP within 10 ft from ally's damage.
act: Apply benefit.
expect: Gain 8 temporary HP without stacking with existing pool. Enemy farther than 10 ft does not trigger when reduced by someone else.

setup: Charisma +3, failed check total 11 and d10 result 5.
act: Use before outcome takes effect.
expect: Check becomes 16. Spend one of three uses and allow no second use on same roll. Long Rest restores all.

setup: Advance Fiend Warlock 3,5,7,9.
act: Inspect automatic preparations.
expect: Grant the printed Fiend spells at those levels beyond ordinary prepared count. Fire Shield at 7 remains visible but unavailable through its lighting dependency.

setup: Finish Short Rest and choose Cold.
act: Take 12 Cold then finish another rest and choose Fire.
expect: Initially Cold becomes 6. New choice replaces Cold resistance with Fire; Force cannot be selected.

setup: Hit a non-Fiend, failed Charisma, eight d10s roll 4.
act: Accept feature and end next caster turn.
expect: Target disappears, takes 32 Psychic and is Incapacitated until returning at boundary. Recharge once per Long Rest or spend Pact slot to restore; Fiend target skips Psychic damage.

setup: Maximum Pact slots three, all spent.
act: Perform one-minute rite twice without rest.
expect: First restores two, rounded up. A second explicit invocation warns about its spent allowance and records invalid use under A01.

setup: Warlock reaches 11,13,15,17.
act: Choose one spell at corresponding 6th/7th/8th/9th level and cast each free.
expect: Each has its own once-per-Long-Rest use, no generated high-level spell slots. Level-up replacement stays at the same arcanum spell level.

setup: Level-5 Warlock, Charisma +3, proficiency +3, both Pact slots spent.
act: Finish Short Rest and cast a legal level-1 prepared spell using Pact.
expect: Restore two level-3 slots. Cast scales to level 3, attack +6 and save DC 14. Keep separate from multiclass ordinary slots.

setup: Normal Warlock spell choices without other grants.
act: Select Eldritch Blast and Hex, then try Druidcraft.
expect: First two are legal at listed levels. Druidcraft needs separate granting feature. Deferred spells retain visible list membership.

setup: Wizard level 5 with spent slots.
act: Finish Short Rest, recover a level-3 slot, then rest again before Long Rest.
expect: Recover at most three combined slot levels once. No level-6+ slot and no second recovery before Long Rest.

setup: Intelligence +4 and Wizard Evocation has two separate damage rolls.
act: Choose one damage roll.
expect: Add +4 once to that roll, not each separate roll. Non-Evocation or non-Wizard spell gains none.

setup: Level 3 Evoker chooses two Evocation Wizard spells at level 2 or below.
act: Apply then unlock level-3 class slots.
expect: Add first two to book free, then one eligible Evocation spell when new slot level unlocks. These are book entries, not automatic prepared spells.

setup: Damage spell uses level-3 slot; use once then repeat before Long Rest. All penalty d12s roll 4.
act: Maximize damage on casting turn.
expect: First use has no penalty. Second deals 24 Necrotic to caster, ignoring Resistance and Immunity, after cast. Later ongoing damage is not maximized by this casting-turn effect.

setup: Cantrip damage roll totals 9 and attack misses.
act: Resolve against creature.
expect: Deal 4 of the cantrip's damage type before defenses and no additional rider. Successful save also takes half damage through this feature.

setup: Level-3 Evocation spell catches four selected visible allies and an enemy.
act: Apply feature.
expect: Four allies automatically save and take zero instead of half. Enemy resolves normal save and damage.

setup: Wizard book has legal level-1+ prepared A and unprepared B.
act: Finish Short Rest and replace A with B.
expect: Preparation changes once, preserving book entries. No spell is created outside the book.

setup: Unprepared Alarm is in book with Ritual tag.
act: Read book and cast as Ritual.
expect: Permit without preparing or spending slot, using ritual cast time and required components.

setup: Proficient Arcana selected, proficiency +3.
act: Apply feature and check Arcana.
expect: Proficiency component is +6, with only chosen legal proficient skill gaining Expertise.

setup: Two level-3 book spells selected.
act: Cast each free then finish Short Rest.
expect: Both always prepared and each has independent free cast restored by Short Rest. Higher-level use spends a slot.

setup: Choose action-time level-1 and level-2 book spells.
act: Cast at lowest levels repeatedly, then upcast and replace one on Long Rest.
expect: Lowest-level casts cost no slots. Upcast costs selected slot. Rest replacement stays same level and action-time eligibility.

setup: Charisma +3, Fireball catches three protected allies; one point available.
act: Apply and resolve their saves.
expect: Spend one point; selected allies automatically save and take zero rather than half. Unselected targets resolve normally.

setup: Eligible range 60-ft spell and separate Touch spell.
act: Spend one point in each independent run.
expect: Ranges become 120 ft and 30 ft respectively for those casts, preserving other eligibility.

setup: Charisma +3, damage dice 1/2/3/4, replacement dice 5/5/1.
act: Reroll first three for one point.
expect: Use replacements even the worse 1. Final dice 5/5/1/4 total 15. Can combine under its express exception.

setup: Concentration spell lasts 10 minutes.
act: Spend one point, then make concentration save.
expect: Duration 20 minutes and concentration saves have Advantage. Cap extension at 24 hours.

setup: Spell has two targets and recurring saves.
act: Spend two points selecting one target.
expect: Selected target's saves against that spell have Disadvantage throughout; other target's saves are unchanged.

setup: Action spell and no prior level-1+ spell cast this turn.
act: Spend two points then attempt another level-1+ spell.
expect: Cast becomes Bonus Action. Another level-1+ cast this turn is barred by the option; a prior such cast would prevent Quickened.

setup: Spell attack misses and replacement d20 is lower.
act: Spend one point.
expect: Use the new d20 even if worse and resolve once. It may combine under its express exception.

setup: Spell has Verbal, Somatic and ordinary Material components; compare a consumed-cost Material.
act: Spend one point.
expect: Remove V/S/ordinary M requirements for that cast. Retain consumed or specified-cost components.

setup: Spell deals Fire and a separate Necrotic component.
act: Spend one point choosing Cold.
expect: Fire changes to Cold. Necrotic is outside eligible set and remains unchanged.

setup: Charm Person cast with level-1 slot can upcast for an extra target.
act: Spend one point.
expect: Effective level becomes 2 for the spell's effect, including one added target. Spend the actual level-1 slot and one point; do not create a level-2 slot.

setup: Level 2, Charisma +3, selected Eldritch Blast beam die 5.
act: Hit twice as legal beams.
expect: Each selected cantrip damage roll gains +3, so each beam deals 8 Force. Repeated invocation must choose a different eligible cantrip.

setup: Unarmored Warlock with no available slots.
act: Cast Mage Armor on self.
expect: Spend no slot and apply Mage Armor normally. Another target cannot use this invocation's cast.

setup: Level-5 Warlock and legal self Levitate.
act: Cast through invocation.
expect: No slot spent; ordinary spell concentration, action and self targeting remain.

setup: Eligible level and invocation selected.
act: Review grant and attempt execution.
expect: Record unavailable special-sense reason and acknowledgment. Create no simulated Darkvision or lighting bypass.

setup: Level 12 with Thirsting Blade and pact weapon.
act: Take Attack action.
expect: Three pact-weapon attacks replace the lower count. An ordinary nonpact weapon gains no extra attacks.

setup: Warlock makes concentration Constitution save and unrelated Constitution save.
act: Roll both.
expect: Only concentration save gains this invocation's Advantage.

setup: Level 5 with Pact Blade, level-3 Pact slot and eligible hit; all d8s 4.
act: Spend slot and knock a Huge target Prone.
expect: Add 16 Force and Prone without separate save. Once per turn. Ordinary Spellcasting slots cannot pay this invocation.

setup: Level-4 Warlock chooses eligible cantrip range 120 ft.
act: Apply.
expect: Range becomes 240 ft, adding 30 times Warlock level. Repeat choice must use different eligible cantrip.

setup: Level 2, self False Life and no slots.
act: Cast through invocation.
expect: Gain maximum 12 temporary HP from 2d4+4 without rolling or stacking. No slot spent.

setup: Eligible invocation and willing adjacent creature.
act: Attempt use.
expect: Unavailable special-sense-dependent branch spends no Bonus Action/resources and creates no remote viewing/casting link.

setup: Level 5 and Speed 30.
act: Apply and use free Water Breathing.
expect: Grant underwater breathing and Swim Speed 30. One free spell cast per Long Rest, with ordinary slotted casts still possible.

setup: Level 9, Tome, Charisma +3 and three permitted names in book.
act: Two named creatures would drop to 0 without outright death before rest.
expect: First instead drops to 1. Feature is then spent for every name until Long Rest. Fourth name exceeds capacity.

setup: Level 5 Chain familiar and Warlock DC 15.
act: Choose Fly, command attack as Bonus Action, select Radiant, then react to 12 damage.
expect: Familiar gains Fly 40, uses Warlock DC 15, can attack through command, changes chosen physical damage to Radiant and takes 6 from reaction Resistance.

setup: Level 2 and Origin feat Alert available.
act: Select then take again with Skilled.
expect: Both legal distinct Origin feats. Duplicate feat choice through repeated invocation is ineligible.

setup: Level 9 pact hit, rider d6 4, spent healing Hit Point Die 6 and Constitution +2.
act: Choose Psychic and spend own die.
expect: Add 4 Psychic once on turn and heal 8 up to max. Consume chosen Hit Point Die.

setup: Level 2, Disguise Self.
act: Cast through invocation.
expect: No slot spent. Normal spell duration and physical-inspection limits apply.

setup: Level 5 and Alter Self legal.
act: Cast through invocation.
expect: No slot spent; normal action, concentration and selectable effects apply.

setup: Level 2, Silent Image legal.
act: Cast through invocation.
expect: No slot spent; maintain its normal concentration and geometry.

setup: Level 5 and chosen invocation.
act: Attempt free Invisible cast.
expect: Unavailable lighting dependency is shown before execution. Spend no resources or action.

setup: Level 2, Jump on self legal.
act: Cast through invocation.
expect: No slot spent; target is self and ordinary Jump duration/movement rules apply.

setup: Charisma +4 vs Strength +1 and legal conjured melee weapon.
act: Use Bonus Action, hit with die 5 choosing Radiant, then keep weapon over 5 ft away for one minute.
expect: Gain proficiency/focus, attack uses +4 and damage 9 Radiant. Bond ends after separation interval and conjured weapon vanishes.

setup: Choose legal Imp form and required Material components available.
act: Cast Find Familiar as Magic action without slot, then forgo own Attack-action attack.
expect: Create chosen familiar; sacrificed attack permits one familiar Reaction attack. Preserve normal component requirements unless another feature waives them.

setup: Finish Short Rest and choose three new cantrips and two new level-1 Rituals.
act: Carry book, cast a chosen Ritual then conjure replacement book.
expect: Spells count as Warlock preparations while book carried and focus is available. New book replaces prior one and updates chosen grants.

setup: Level 2 chosen cantrip attack hits Large target with unobstructed path.
act: Choose maximum push.
expect: Move target 10 ft straight away without a save. Huge target is ineligible.

setup: Level 5 with Pact Blade.
act: Attack using pact weapon then compare nonpact weapon.
expect: Pact weapon permits two attacks. Nonpact weapon gains no extra count from this invocation.

setup: Level 9 and Arcane Eye invocation path selected.
act: Attempt free cast.
expect: Arcane Eye's special-sense dependency propagates to this path. Show unavailable reason and spend no resources.

setup: Level 7, eligible Speak with Dead target.
act: Cast through invocation.
expect: No slot spent; normal action, components, corpse and question limits remain.

setup: Level 15 with invocation selected.
act: Attempt use.
expect: Truesight 30-ft grant remains visible unavailable with acknowledgment and no simulated sense.
